hi.R: शमौन ने भी विश्वास किया और बपतिस्मा लिया। उसके बाद जहाँ कहीं फिलिप्पुस जाता, शमौन उसके साथ रहता था। शमौन ने वे चिह्न और बड़े-बड़े चमत्कार देखे जो फिलिप्पुस करता था, और वह हैरान रह गया।

ru.L: Симон же и сам поверил и, крестившись, держался Филиппа; видя же знамения и совершающиеся великие чудеса, изумлялся.
ru.B: Даже сам Симон поверил и после крещения не отходил от Филиппа. Видя знамения и великие чудеса, которые совершались, он был поражён.
ru.R: Симон тоже поверил и крестился. После этого он везде ходил с Филиппом. Симон видел знаки и великие чудеса, которые делал Филипп, и удивлялся.

uk.L: І сам Симон також повірив і, охрестившись, тримався Филипа; і, бачачи знаки й великі чудеса, що відбувалися, дивувався.
uk.B: Навіть сам Симон повірив, а охрестившись, не відходив від Филипа. Бачачи знаки й великі чудеса, що відбувалися, він був вражений.
uk.R: Симон також повірив і охрестився. Після цього він усюди ходив з Филипом. Симон бачив знаки й великі чудеса, які робив Филип, і дуже дивувався.

ja.L: そしてシモン自身も信じ、洗礼を受けてからはフィリポにずっとついていた。そして、しるしと大いなる力ある業が起こるのを見て、驚いていた。
ja.B: シモン自身も信じて洗礼を受け、いつもフィリポのそばを離れなかった。そして、しるしや大きな奇跡が行われるのを見て、すっかり驚いていた。
ja.R: シモンも信じて、洗礼を受けました。それからは、フィリポの行く所にどこへでもついて行きました。シモンは、フィリポが行うしるしや大きな奇跡を見て、驚きました。

decisions.choice: believed: Simon professed faith and was baptized, but his heart was not right (8:21)
alternatives: Simon's belief was full and sincere
decisions.reason: Luke uses the same verb as for the others in 8:12. But 8:18-23 shows that Simon still thought of God's gift as a power to buy. Luke does not say whether his belief was real but immature or only on the surface.

decisions.choice: continuing with: staying close to, attaching himself to
decisions.reason: The verb means to hold fast to someone or something, as the believers held fast to prayer (1:14, 2:42).

decisions.choice: he was amazed: the same verb used of the effect of his own magic (8:9, 8:11)
decisions.reason: Simon had amazed others; now he is amazed himself.

decisions.choice: that Philip did
decisions.reason: Readable names who did the miracles, as 8:6 says.

decisions.choice: obras poderosas (L, B); milagros (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for these acts of power: "obras poderosas" keeps the Greek word's link with power at Literal and Balanced; Readable says plainly "milagros", as the English does.

decisions.choice: stupéfait (L), frappé de stupeur (B), très étonné (R)
decisions.reason: Each level uses the word it used for the effect of Simon's magic in 8:9 and 8:11, so that the reader sees the same verb turned back on him (m3).

decisions.choice: matendo ya nguvu (L, B); miujiza (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for these acts of power: "matendo ya nguvu" keeps the Greek word's link with power at Literal and Balanced; Readable says plainly "miujiza", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "phép lạ" for "dynameis", the miracles beside the signs
decisions.reason: Here God's works stand beside Simon's own wonders (meaning decision), and "phép lạ" sets them apart from his "phép thuật".

decisions.choice: "놀라다" for existēmi, as in 8:9 and 8:11
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of the effect of Simon's own magic (meaning decision); Korean keeps one verb so the turn shows: the one who amazed others is now amazed.

decisions.choice: ይገረም ነበር (L); ተደነቀ (B)
alternatives: different words for Simon's amazement and the people's
decisions.reason: Luke uses the same verb for the amazement Simon's magic caused (8:9, 8:11) and for Simon's own amazement here (m3); Literal uses the same Amharic root in both places (ያስገርም, ይገረም), and Balanced does too (ያስደንቅ, ተደነቀ), so the turn of the tables can be seen.

decisions.choice: "सामर्थ्य के बड़े-बड़े काम" (L, B); "बड़े-बड़े चमत्कार" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is "powers", deeds of power; Literal and Balanced keep the idea of power, Readable says miracles. "चिह्न" stays for signs.

decisions.choice: "驚いていた" (L, B), "驚きました" (R), the same verb as "驚かせ" in 8:9 and 8:11
decisions.reason: The Greek uses one verb for Simon amazing the people and for Simon being amazed (m3). Japanese keeps the one word "驚く" so the turn can be seen.

source.text: Ἀκούσαντες δὲ οἱ ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἀπόστολοι ὅτι δέδεκται ἡ Σαμάρεια τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ, ἀπέστειλαν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην, οἵτινες καταβάντες προσηύξαντο περὶ αὐτῶν ὅπως λάβωσιν πνεῦμα ἅγιον·

records.literal_gloss: Having heard now the in Jerusalem apostles that had received Samaria the word of God, they sent to them Peter and John, \v 15 who having come down prayed for them so that they might receive Spirit Holy;

en.L: Now when the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them, \v 15 who, having come down, prayed for them so that they might receive [the] Holy Spirit;
en.B: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had accepted the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them. \v 15 The two went down and prayed for the people there to receive the Holy Spirit,
en.R: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that the people of Samaria had accepted God's message. So they sent Peter and John to them. \v 15 When Peter and John arrived, they prayed for the believers in Samaria. They asked God to give them the Holy Spirit.

es.L: Y cuando los apóstoles en Jerusalén oyeron que Samaria había recibido la palabra de Dios, les enviaron a Pedro y a Juan, \v 15 quienes, habiendo bajado, oraron por ellos para que recibieran [el] Espíritu Santo;
es.B: Cuando los apóstoles en Jerusalén se enteraron de que Samaria había aceptado la palabra de Dios, les enviaron a Pedro y a Juan. \v 15 Ellos bajaron y oraron por los de allí para que recibieran el Espíritu Santo,
es.R: Los apóstoles en Jerusalén supieron que la gente de Samaria había aceptado el mensaje de Dios. Por eso les enviaron a Pedro y a Juan. \v 15 Cuando Pedro y Juan llegaron, oraron por los creyentes de Samaria. Le pidieron a Dios que les diera el Espíritu Santo.

fr.L: Or les apôtres [qui étaient] à Jérusalem, ayant appris que la Samarie avait reçu la parole de Dieu, leur envoyèrent Pierre et Jean, \v 15 qui, étant descendus, prièrent pour eux afin qu’ils reçoivent l’Esprit Saint ;
fr.B: Quand les apôtres qui étaient à Jérusalem apprirent que la Samarie avait accueilli la parole de Dieu, ils leur envoyèrent Pierre et Jean. \v 15 Arrivés là-bas, ceux-ci prièrent pour que les gens reçoivent l’Esprit Saint,
fr.R: Les apôtres de Jérusalem ont appris que les gens de Samarie avaient accepté le message de Dieu. Alors ils leur ont envoyé Pierre et Jean. \v 15 Quand Pierre et Jean sont arrivés, ils ont prié pour les croyants de Samarie. Ils ont demandé à Dieu de leur donner l’Esprit Saint.

sw.L: Basi mitume waliokuwa Yerusalemu waliposikia kwamba Samaria imelipokea neno la Mungu, waliwatuma kwao Petro na Yohana, \v 15 ambao, wakiisha kushuka, waliwaombea ili wampokee Roho Mtakatifu;
sw.B: Mitume waliokuwa Yerusalemu waliposikia kwamba Samaria imelikubali neno la Mungu, waliwatuma Petro na Yohana kwao. \v 15 Hao wawili walishuka, wakawaombea watu wa huko ili wampokee Roho Mtakatifu,
sw.R: Mitume waliokuwa Yerusalemu walisikia kwamba watu wa Samaria wameukubali ujumbe wa Mungu. Kwa hiyo waliwatuma Petro na Yohana kwao. \v 15 Petro na Yohana walipofika, waliwaombea waumini wa Samaria. Walimwomba Mungu awape Roho Mtakatifu.

vi.L: Khi các sứ đồ ở Giê-ru-sa-lem nghe tin rằng Sa-ma-ri đã tiếp nhận lời Đức Chúa Trời, họ sai Phi-e-rơ và Giăng đến với họ. \v 15 Hai ông xuống đó và cầu nguyện cho họ để họ nhận lãnh Đức Thánh Linh;
vi.B: Khi các sứ đồ ở Giê-ru-sa-lem nghe tin Sa-ma-ri đã tiếp nhận lời Đức Chúa Trời, họ sai Phi-e-rơ và Giăng đến đó. \v 15 Hai ông xuống và cầu nguyện cho dân chúng ở đó được nhận lãnh Đức Thánh Linh,
vi.R: Các sứ đồ ở Giê-ru-sa-lem nghe tin dân Sa-ma-ri đã tiếp nhận sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời. Vì vậy họ sai Phi-e-rơ và Giăng đến với những người ấy. \v 15 Khi Phi-e-rơ và Giăng đến nơi, hai ông cầu nguyện cho các tín hữu ở Sa-ma-ri. Hai ông xin Đức Chúa Trời ban Đức Thánh Linh cho họ.

ko.L: 그런데 예루살렘에 있는 사도들이 사마리아가 하나님의 말씀을 받아들였다는 말을 듣고, 베드로와 요한을 그들에게 보냈다. \v 15 그들은 내려가서, 그들이 성령을 받도록 그들을 위하여 기도했다.
ko.B: 예루살렘에 있는 사도들은 사마리아 사람들이 하나님의 말씀을 받아들였다는 소식을 듣고, 베드로와 요한을 그들에게 보냈다. \v 15 두 사람은 그곳에 내려가서, 그곳 사람들이 성령을 받도록 기도했다.
ko.R: 예루살렘에 있는 사도들은 사마리아 사람들이 하나님의 말씀을 받아들였다는 소식을 들었다. 그래서 베드로와 요한을 그들에게 보냈다. \v 15 베드로와 요한은 그곳에 도착해서 사마리아의 믿는 사람들을 위하여 기도했다. 그들은 하나님께 이 사람들에게 성령을 주시기를 구했다.

pt.L: Ora, quando os apóstolos em Jerusalém ouviram que Samaria tinha recebido a palavra de Deus, enviaram-lhes Pedro e João, \v 15 os quais, tendo descido, oraram por eles para que recebessem [o] Espírito Santo;
pt.B: Quando os apóstolos em Jerusalém souberam que Samaria tinha aceitado a palavra de Deus, enviaram Pedro e João até lá. \v 15 Os dois desceram e oraram para que o povo de lá recebesse o Espírito Santo,
pt.R: Os apóstolos em Jerusalém ficaram sabendo que o povo de Samaria tinha aceitado a mensagem de Deus. Então enviaram Pedro e João até eles. \v 15 Quando Pedro e João chegaram, oraram pelas pessoas de Samaria que acreditavam em Jesus. Eles pediram a Deus que desse a elas o Espírito Santo.

am.L: በኢየሩሳሌም ያሉት ሐዋርያትም ሰማርያ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እንደ ተቀበለች በሰሙ ጊዜ ጴጥሮስንና ዮሐንስን ወደ እነርሱ ላኩ፤ \v 15 እነርሱም ወርደው መንፈስ ቅዱስን እንዲቀበሉ ስለ እነርሱ ጸለዩ፤
am.B: በኢየሩሳሌም የነበሩት ሐዋርያት ሰማርያ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እንደ ተቀበለች በሰሙ ጊዜ ጴጥሮስንና ዮሐንስን ወደዚያ ላኩ። \v 15 ሁለቱም ወርደው በዚያ ያሉት ሰዎች መንፈስ ቅዱስን እንዲቀበሉ ጸለዩላቸው፤
am.R: በኢየሩሳሌም ያሉት ሐዋርያት የሰማርያ ሰዎች የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እንደ ተቀበሉ ሰሙ። ስለዚህ ጴጥሮስንና ዮሐንስን ወደ እነርሱ ላኩ። \v 15 ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ በደረሱ ጊዜ በሰማርያ ላሉት አማኞች ጸለዩላቸው። እግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ቅዱስን እንዲሰጣቸው ለመኑ።

hi.L: और जब यरूशलेम के प्रेरितों ने सुना कि सामरिया ने परमेश्वर का वचन ग्रहण कर लिया है, तो उन्होंने पतरस और यूहन्ना को उनके पास भेजा, \v 15 जिन्होंने उतरकर उनके लिए प्रार्थना की कि वे पवित्र आत्मा पाएँ;
hi.B: जब यरूशलेम में प्रेरितों ने सुना कि सामरिया के लोगों ने परमेश्वर का वचन स्वीकार कर लिया है, तो उन्होंने पतरस और यूहन्ना को उनके पास भेजा। \v 15 वे दोनों वहाँ गए और उन्होंने वहाँ के लोगों के लिए प्रार्थना की कि वे पवित्र आत्मा पाएँ,
hi.R: यरूशलेम में प्रेरितों ने सुना कि सामरिया के लोगों ने परमेश्वर का संदेश मान लिया है। इसलिए उन्होंने पतरस और यूहन्ना को उनके पास भेजा। \v 15 जब पतरस और यूहन्ना वहाँ पहुँचे, तो उन्होंने सामरिया के विश्वासियों के लिए प्रार्थना की। उन्होंने परमेश्वर से माँगा कि वह उन्हें पवित्र आत्मा दें।

ru.L: Услышав же апостолы в Иерусалиме, что Самария приняла слово Божье, послали к ним Петра и Иоанна, \v 15 которые, сойдя, помолились за них, чтобы они приняли Духа Святого;
ru.B: Когда апостолы в Иерусалиме услышали, что Самария приняла слово Божье, они послали к ним Петра и Иоанна. \v 15 Те пришли и помолились за них, чтобы они получили Святого Духа,
ru.R: Апостолы в Иерусалиме услышали, что жители Самарии приняли Божью весть. Поэтому они послали к ним Петра и Иоанна. \v 15 Пётр и Иоанн пришли и помолились за верующих в Самарии. Они просили Бога дать им Святого Духа.

uk.L: А апостоли в Єрусалимі, почувши, що Самарія прийняла Боже слово, послали до них Петра й Івана, \v 15 які, зійшовши, помолилися за них, щоб вони прийняли Святого Духа;
uk.B: Коли апостоли в Єрусалимі почули, що Самарія прийняла Боже слово, вони послали до них Петра й Івана. \v 15 Ті прийшли й помолилися за тамтешніх людей, щоб вони прийняли Святого Духа,
uk.R: Апостоли в Єрусалимі почули, що жителі Самарії прийняли Боже послання. Тож вони послали до них Петра й Івана. \v 15 Коли Петро й Іван прийшли, вони помолилися за віруючих у Самарії. Вони просили Бога дати їм Святого Духа.

ja.L: さて、エルサレムにいる使徒たちは、サマリアが神の言葉を受け入れたと聞いて、ペトロとヨハネを彼らのところに遣わした。\v 15 二人は下って行って、彼らが聖霊を受けるようにと、彼らのために祈った。
ja.B: エルサレムにいる使徒たちは、サマリアの人々が神の言葉を受け入れたと聞き、ペトロとヨハネをそこへ遣わした。\v 15 二人は下って行き、人々が聖霊を受けるようにと祈った。
ja.R: エルサレムにいる使徒たちは、サマリアの人々が神の言葉を受け入れたと聞きました。そこで、ペトロとヨハネをサマリアに送りました。\v 15 ペトロとヨハネは着くと、サマリアの信じた人々のために祈りました。この人たちに聖霊を与えてくださるようにと、神に願ったのです。

decisions.choice: Samaria had received the word of God: the people of Samaria had accepted the message
decisions.reason: Luke names the region for its people. To receive the word is to accept it in faith, as in 2:41 and 11:1.

decisions.choice: they sent Peter and John: the apostles in Jerusalem took part in the new work
alternatives: they were sent to check on Philip
decisions.reason: Luke does not give the reason for sending them. The same thing happens when the word reaches Antioch (11:22). Peter and John had worked together before (3:1, 4:13).

decisions.choice: so that they might receive: the purpose of their prayer
decisions.reason: The conjunction gives the aim. Verse 17 tells that it came about.

decisions.choice: the sentence runs on into 8:16, which gives the reason for the prayer
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT ends this record with a raised dot. Verse 16 explains why they prayed: the Spirit had not yet come upon any of them.

decisions.choice: they asked God to give them
decisions.reason: Readable says to whom they prayed and what they asked.

decisions.choice: l’Esprit Saint
decisions.reason: The style guide's term, as in John and Hebrews. The Greek has no article here; French needs one, so Literal writes it without brackets.

source.text: οὐδέπω γὰρ ἦν ἐπ’ οὐδενὶ αὐτῶν ἐπιπεπτωκός, μόνον δὲ βεβαπτισμένοι ὑπῆρχον εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Not yet for was upon any of them fallen, only however having been baptized they were into the name of the Lord Jesus.

en.L: For [the Spirit] had not yet fallen upon any of them; they had only been baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
en.B: for the Spirit had not yet come down on any of them. They had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
en.R: The Holy Spirit had not yet come on any of them. They had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

es.L: Porque [el Espíritu] todavía no había caído sobre ninguno de ellos; solo habían sido bautizados en el nombre del Señor Jesús.
es.B: porque el Espíritu todavía no había descendido sobre ninguno de ellos. Solo habían sido bautizados en el nombre del Señor Jesús.
es.R: El Espíritu Santo todavía no había venido sobre ninguno de ellos. Solo habían sido bautizados en el nombre del Señor Jesús.

fr.L: Car [l’Esprit] n’était encore tombé sur aucun d’eux ; ils avaient seulement été baptisés dans le nom du Seigneur Jésus.
fr.B: car l’Esprit n’était encore descendu sur aucun d’eux. Ils avaient seulement été baptisés au nom du Seigneur Jésus.
fr.R: L’Esprit Saint n’était encore venu sur aucun d’eux. Ils avaient seulement été baptisés au nom du Seigneur Jésus.

sw.L: Kwa maana [Roho] alikuwa bado hajamshukia yeyote kati yao; walikuwa wamebatizwa tu kuingia katika jina la Bwana Yesu.
sw.B: kwa kuwa Roho alikuwa bado hajamshukia hata mmoja wao. Walikuwa wamebatizwa tu kwa jina la Bwana Yesu.
sw.R: Roho Mtakatifu alikuwa bado hajaja juu ya yeyote kati yao. Walikuwa wamebatizwa tu kwa jina la Bwana Yesu.

vi.L: vì [Thánh Linh] chưa giáng xuống trên một ai trong họ; họ chỉ mới chịu báp-têm trong danh Chúa Giê-xu mà thôi.
vi.B: vì Thánh Linh chưa ngự xuống trên một ai trong họ. Họ chỉ mới chịu báp-têm trong danh Chúa Giê-xu.
vi.R: Đức Thánh Linh chưa ngự xuống trên một ai trong họ. Họ chỉ mới chịu báp-têm trong danh Chúa Giê-xu.

ko.L: 아직 그들 가운데 누구에게도 [성령께서] 내려오지 않으셨고, 그들은 다만 주 예수의 이름으로 세례만 받았을 뿐이었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들 가운데 아직 아무에게도 성령께서 내려오지 않으셨기 때문이다. 그들은 다만 주 예수의 이름으로 세례만 받았을 뿐이었다.
ko.R: 아직 성령께서 그들 가운데 아무에게도 오지 않으셨다. 그들은 다만 주 예수의 이름으로 세례를 받았을 뿐이었다.

pt.L: Pois [o Espírito] ainda não tinha caído sobre nenhum deles; apenas tinham sido batizados no nome do Senhor Jesus.
pt.B: pois o Espírito ainda não tinha descido sobre nenhum deles. Eles tinham sido apenas batizados em nome do Senhor Jesus.
pt.R: O Espírito Santo ainda não tinha vindo sobre nenhum deles. Eles tinham sido apenas batizados em nome do Senhor Jesus.

am.L: [መንፈስ] በአንዳቸውም ላይ ገና አልወረደም ነበርና፤ በጌታ በኢየሱስ ስም ብቻ ተጠምቀው ነበር።
am.B: መንፈስ ገና በአንዳቸውም ላይ አልወረደም ነበርና፤ የተጠመቁት በጌታ በኢየሱስ ስም ብቻ ነበር።
am.R: መንፈስ ቅዱስ ገና በአንዳቸውም ላይ አልመጣም ነበር። የተጠመቁት በጌታ በኢየሱስ ስም ብቻ ነበር።

hi.L: क्योंकि [आत्मा] अब तक उनमें से किसी पर नहीं उतरा था; उन्होंने केवल प्रभु यीशु के नाम में बपतिस्मा लिया था।
hi.B: क्योंकि आत्मा अभी तक उनमें से किसी पर नहीं उतरा था। उन्होंने केवल प्रभु यीशु के नाम से बपतिस्मा लिया था।
hi.R: पवित्र आत्मा अभी तक उनमें से किसी पर नहीं आया था। उन्होंने केवल प्रभु यीशु के नाम से बपतिस्मा लिया था।

ru.L: Ведь [Дух] ещё ни на кого из них не сходил, они были только крещены во имя Господа Иисуса.
ru.B: ведь Дух ещё не сошёл ни на кого из них. Они были только крещены во имя Господа Иисуса.
ru.R: Святой Дух ещё не сошёл ни на кого из них. Они были только крещены во имя Господа Иисуса.

uk.L: Бо [Дух] ще не зійшов ні на кого з них; вони були тільки охрещені в імʼя Господа Ісуса.
uk.B: бо Дух іще не зійшов ні на кого з них. Вони були тільки охрещені в імʼя Господа Ісуса.
uk.R: Святий Дух іще не зійшов ні на кого з них. Вони були тільки охрещені в імʼя Господа Ісуса.

ja.L: というのは、[霊は]まだだれの上にも降っておられなかったからである。彼らはただ、主イエスの名へと洗礼を受けていただけであった。
ja.B: 霊はまだ、だれの上にも降っておられなかったのである。彼らは主イエスの名によって洗礼を受けていただけであった。
ja.R: 聖霊は、まだだれの上にも来ておられなかったのです。人々は、主イエスの名によって洗礼を受けていただけでした。

decisions.choice: had not yet fallen upon: the Spirit had not yet come on them as at Pentecost
decisions.reason: Luke uses the same picture for the Spirit coming on Cornelius's household (10:44, 11:15). He does not say why the gift was delayed in Samaria. One reading sees God joining the Samaritans to the apostles' work in Jerusalem, so that the long divide between the two peoples would not carry into the church; but the text does not explain it.

decisions.choice: baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus: baptized as belonging to Jesus
decisions.reason: "Into the name" marks to whom the baptized now belong. Compare 2:38 and 19:5.

decisions.choice: the Spirit
decisions.reason: The Greek verb has no stated subject; it is the Holy Spirit of 8:15. English names him rather than using a pronoun.

decisions.choice: dans le nom (L); au nom (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the preposition of movement ("into the name"), which says that they now belonged to Jesus (m2); Balanced and Readable use the usual French "baptisés au nom de".

decisions.choice: "[성령께서]" (L), "성령께서" (B, R), with the honorific
decisions.reason: The Greek leaves the subject to be understood; Korean needs it, as the English supplies "the Spirit". The Spirit takes the honorific, as in 1:8.

decisions.choice: no nome (L); em nome (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps a preposition of place for the Greek "into the name"; "para o nome" would copy the Greek but means nothing in Portuguese. Balanced and Readable use the ordinary formula "em nome de", as the English says "in the name".

decisions.choice: "उतरा था" (masculine)
decisions.reason: As the style guide has it, the Spirit who acts as a person takes masculine agreement, as Hindi Bibles have it; the same through Acts.

decisions.choice: "主イエスの名へと" (L); "主イエスの名によって" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek "into the name", which marks to whom the baptized belong (m2). Balanced and Readable use the usual Japanese phrase for baptism in someone's name.

source.text: τότε ἐπετίθεσαν τὰς χεῖρας ἐπ’ αὐτούς, καὶ ἐλάμβανον πνεῦμα ἅγιον.

records.literal_gloss: Then they were laying the hands on them, and they were receiving Spirit Holy.

en.L: Then they laid [their] hands on them, and they received [the] Holy Spirit.
en.B: Then Peter and John laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
en.R: Then Peter and John put their hands on the believers, and they received the Holy Spirit.

es.L: Entonces imponían las manos sobre ellos, y recibían [el] Espíritu Santo.
es.B: Entonces Pedro y Juan les impusieron las manos, y recibieron el Espíritu Santo.
es.R: Entonces Pedro y Juan pusieron las manos sobre los creyentes, y ellos recibieron el Espíritu Santo.

fr.L: Alors ils leur imposaient les mains, et ils recevaient l’Esprit Saint.
fr.B: Alors Pierre et Jean leur imposèrent les mains, et ils reçurent l’Esprit Saint.
fr.R: Alors Pierre et Jean ont posé les mains sur les croyants, et ceux-ci ont reçu l’Esprit Saint.

sw.L: Kisha walikuwa wakiweka mikono juu yao, nao walikuwa wakimpokea Roho Mtakatifu.
sw.B: Kisha Petro na Yohana waliweka mikono yao juu yao, nao wakampokea Roho Mtakatifu.
sw.R: Kisha Petro na Yohana waliweka mikono yao juu ya waumini, nao wakampokea Roho Mtakatifu.

vi.L: Bấy giờ hai ông đặt tay trên họ, và họ nhận lãnh Đức Thánh Linh.
vi.B: Rồi Phi-e-rơ và Giăng đặt tay trên họ, và họ nhận lãnh Đức Thánh Linh.
vi.R: Rồi Phi-e-rơ và Giăng đặt tay trên các tín hữu, và họ nhận được Đức Thánh Linh.

ko.L: 그때 그들이 그들에게 손을 얹으니, 그들이 성령을 받았다.
ko.B: 그때 베드로와 요한이 그들에게 손을 얹자, 그들이 성령을 받았다.
ko.R: 그러자 베드로와 요한이 믿는 사람들에게 손을 얹었다. 그러자 그들이 성령을 받았다.

pt.L: Então impunham as mãos sobre eles, e recebiam [o] Espírito Santo.
pt.B: Então Pedro e João impuseram as mãos sobre eles, e eles receberam o Espírito Santo.
pt.R: Então Pedro e João colocaram as mãos sobre aquelas pessoas, e elas receberam o Espírito Santo.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜም እጆቻቸውን ይጭኑባቸው ነበር፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስንም ይቀበሉ ነበር።
am.B: ከዚያም ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ እጆቻቸውን ጫኑባቸው፤ እነርሱም መንፈስ ቅዱስን ተቀበሉ።
am.R: ከዚያም ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ እጆቻቸውን በአማኞቹ ላይ ጫኑ፤ አማኞቹም መንፈስ ቅዱስን ተቀበሉ።

hi.L: तब उन्होंने उन पर हाथ रखे, और उन्होंने पवित्र आत्मा पाया।
hi.B: तब पतरस और यूहन्ना ने उन पर हाथ रखे, और उन्हें पवित्र आत्मा मिला।
hi.R: फिर पतरस और यूहन्ना ने उन विश्वासियों पर अपने हाथ रखे, और उन्हें पवित्र आत्मा मिल गया।

ru.L: Тогда они возлагали на них руки, и они получали Духа Святого.
ru.B: Тогда Пётр и Иоанн возложили на них руки, и они получили Святого Духа.
ru.R: Тогда Пётр и Иоанн положили руки на верующих, и те получили Святого Духа.

uk.L: Тоді вони покладали [свої] руки на них, і ті приймали Святого Духа.
uk.B: Тоді Петро й Іван поклали на них руки, і вони прийняли Святого Духа.
uk.R: Тоді Петро й Іван поклали руки на віруючих, і ті прийняли Святого Духа.

ja.L: そのとき、[二人が]彼らの上に手を置いていくと、彼らは聖霊を受けていった。
ja.B: そこでペトロとヨハネが人々の上に手を置くと、人々は聖霊を受けた。
ja.R: そこでペトロとヨハネが、信じた人々の上に手を置くと、その人たちは聖霊を受けました。

decisions.choice: laying on hands: a sign of prayer and blessing for a person
alternatives: a means that works by itself
decisions.reason: Laying on hands goes with prayer in 6:6 and 13:3. In 9:17 Ananias, not an apostle, lays hands on Saul, who is then filled with the Spirit; in 10:44 the Spirit comes with no laying on of hands.

decisions.choice: were laying, were receiving: one after another
decisions.reason: Both verbs are imperfect, which suggests the apostles went from one person to the next.

decisions.choice: Peter and John
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the subject.

source.text: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Σίμων ὅτι διὰ τῆς ἐπιθέσεως τῶν χειρῶν τῶν ἀποστόλων δίδοται τὸ πνεῦμα προσήνεγκεν αὐτοῖς χρήματα λέγων· Δότε κἀμοὶ τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην ἵνα ᾧ ἐὰν ἐπιθῶ τὰς χεῖρας λαμβάνῃ πνεῦμα ἅγιον.

records.literal_gloss: Having seen now the Simon that through the laying on of the hands of the apostles is given the Spirit, he offered them money \v 19 saying, Give also to me the authority this, that on whom if I lay the hands, he may receive Spirit Holy.

en.L: Now when Simon saw that through the laying on of the apostles' hands the Spirit was given, he offered them money, \v 19 saying, "Give me also this authority, so that anyone on whom I lay [my] hands may receive [the] Holy Spirit."
en.B: Simon saw that the Spirit was given when the apostles laid their hands on people, and he offered them money. \v 19 "Let me have this power too," he said, "so that whoever I place my hands on will receive the Holy Spirit."
en.R: Simon saw that the Spirit came to people when the apostles put their hands on them. So he offered Peter and John money. \v 19 He said, "Give me this power too. Then when I put my hands on someone, that person will receive the Holy Spirit."

es.L: Y cuando Simón vio que por la imposición de las manos de los apóstoles se daba el Espíritu, les ofreció dinero, \v 19 diciendo: «{{plural_you:Denme|Dadme}} también a mí esta autoridad, para que cualquiera a quien yo imponga las manos reciba [el] Espíritu Santo».
es.B: Simón vio que el Espíritu se daba cuando los apóstoles imponían las manos a la gente, y les ofreció dinero. \v 19 «{{plural_you:Denme|Dadme}} también a mí este poder —dijo—, para que todo aquel a quien yo le imponga las manos reciba el Espíritu Santo».
es.R: Simón vio que el Espíritu venía sobre la gente cuando los apóstoles le ponían las manos encima. Entonces les ofreció dinero a Pedro y a Juan. \v 19 Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Denme|Dadme}} también a mí este poder. Así, cuando yo le ponga las manos encima a alguien, esa persona recibirá el Espíritu Santo».

fr.L: Or Simon, ayant vu que par l’imposition des mains des apôtres l’Esprit était donné, leur offrit de l’argent, \v 19 disant : « Donnez-moi, à moi aussi, cette autorité, afin que celui à qui j’imposerai les mains reçoive l’Esprit Saint. »
fr.B: Simon vit que l’Esprit était donné quand les apôtres imposaient les mains, et il leur offrit de l’argent. \v 19 « Donnez-moi ce pouvoir, à moi aussi, dit-il, pour que celui à qui j’imposerai les mains reçoive l’Esprit Saint. »
fr.R: Simon a vu que l’Esprit venait sur les gens quand les apôtres posaient les mains sur eux. Alors il a offert de l’argent à Pierre et à Jean. \v 19 Il leur a dit : « Donnez-moi ce pouvoir, à moi aussi. Alors, quand je poserai les mains sur quelqu’un, cette personne recevra l’Esprit Saint. »

sw.L: Na Simoni alipoona kwamba kwa kuwekewa mikono ya mitume Roho hutolewa, aliwaletea fedha, \v 19 akisema, "Nipeni na mimi mamlaka haya, ili kila nitakayemwekea mikono ampokee Roho Mtakatifu."
sw.B: Simoni aliona kwamba Roho alitolewa mitume walipowawekea watu mikono, akawaletea fedha. \v 19 "Nipeni na mimi mamlaka haya," akasema, "ili kila nitakayemwekea mikono yangu ampokee Roho Mtakatifu."
sw.R: Simoni aliona kwamba watu walimpokea Roho mitume walipoweka mikono yao juu yao. Kwa hiyo alitaka kuwapa Petro na Yohana fedha. \v 19 Akasema, "Nipeni na mimi mamlaka haya. Hivyo nikimwekea mtu mikono, mtu huyo atampokea Roho Mtakatifu."

vi.L: Khi Si-môn thấy rằng nhờ các sứ đồ đặt tay mà Thánh Linh được ban cho, ông đem tiền đến cho các sứ đồ \v 19 mà nói: "Xin cũng ban cho tôi quyền này, để tôi đặt tay trên ai, người ấy cũng nhận lãnh Đức Thánh Linh."
vi.B: Si-môn thấy rằng khi các sứ đồ đặt tay trên người ta thì Thánh Linh được ban cho, nên ông đem tiền đến cho họ \v 19 và nói: "Xin cho tôi cũng có quyền năng này, để tôi đặt tay trên ai thì người ấy sẽ nhận lãnh Đức Thánh Linh."
vi.R: Si-môn thấy rằng khi các sứ đồ đặt tay trên người ta thì Thánh Linh đến với những người ấy. Vì vậy ông đem tiền đến cho Phi-e-rơ và Giăng. \v 19 Ông nói: "Xin cho tôi quyền năng này nữa. Như vậy khi tôi đặt tay trên ai, người ấy sẽ nhận được Đức Thánh Linh."

ko.L: 그런데 시몬이 사도들이 손을 얹음으로 성령께서 주어지시는 것을 보고, 그들에게 돈을 가져와 \v 19 말했다. "나에게도 이 권한을 주십시오. 그래서 내가 손을 얹는 사람은 누구나 성령을 받게 해 주십시오."
ko.B: 시몬은 사도들이 손을 얹을 때에 성령께서 내리시는 것을 보고, 그들에게 돈을 내놓으며 \v 19 말했다. "나에게도 이런 권능을 주십시오. 내가 손을 얹는 사람마다 성령을 받게 해 주십시오."
ko.R: 시몬은 사도들이 사람들에게 손을 얹을 때에 성령께서 그 사람들에게 오시는 것을 보았다. 그래서 베드로와 요한에게 돈을 내밀며 \v 19 말했다. "나에게도 이 능력을 주십시오. 내가 누구에게 손을 얹든지, 그 사람이 성령을 받게 해 주십시오."

pt.L: Ora, vendo Simão que pela imposição das mãos dos apóstolos era dado o Espírito, ofereceu-lhes dinheiro, \v 19 dizendo: "Deem também a mim esta autoridade, para que aquele sobre quem eu impuser as mãos receba [o] Espírito Santo."
pt.B: Simão viu que o Espírito era dado quando os apóstolos impunham as mãos sobre as pessoas, e lhes ofereceu dinheiro. \v 19 "Deem também a mim esse poder", disse ele, "para que todo aquele sobre quem eu puser as mãos receba o Espírito Santo."
pt.R: Simão viu que o Espírito vinha sobre as pessoas quando os apóstolos colocavam as mãos sobre elas. Por isso ofereceu dinheiro a Pedro e João. \v 19 Ele disse: "Deem esse poder a mim também. Assim, quando eu colocar as mãos sobre alguém, essa pessoa vai receber o Espírito Santo."

am.L: ስምዖንም በሐዋርያት እጅ መጫን መንፈስ እንደሚሰጥ ባየ ጊዜ ገንዘብ አቀረበላቸው፤ \v 19 እንዲህም አለ፦ «እጄን የምጭንበት ሁሉ መንፈስ ቅዱስን እንዲቀበል ይህን ሥልጣን ለእኔም ስጡኝ።»
am.B: ስምዖን ሐዋርያት እጃቸውን በሰዎች ላይ ሲጭኑ መንፈስ እንደሚሰጥ አየ፤ ገንዘብም አቀረበላቸው። \v 19 «ይህን ኃይል ለእኔም ስጡኝ» አለ፤ «እጄን የምጭንበት ሁሉ መንፈስ ቅዱስን እንዲቀበል።»
am.R: ስምዖን ሐዋርያት እጃቸውን በሰዎች ላይ ሲጭኑ መንፈስ ቅዱስ እንደሚመጣላቸው አየ። ስለዚህ ለጴጥሮስና ለዮሐንስ ገንዘብ አቀረበላቸው። \v 19 እንዲህም አለ፦ «ይህን ኃይል ለእኔም ስጡኝ። ከዚያም እጄን በማንም ላይ ስጭን ያ ሰው መንፈስ ቅዱስን ይቀበላል።»

hi.L: जब शमौन ने देखा कि प्रेरितों के हाथ रखने से आत्मा दिया जाता है, तो उसने उनके पास रुपये लाकर \v 19 कहा, "मुझे भी यह अधिकार दीजिए कि जिस किसी पर मैं हाथ रखूँ, वह पवित्र आत्मा पाए।"
hi.B: शमौन ने देखा कि जब प्रेरित लोगों पर हाथ रखते हैं, तो आत्मा दिया जाता है। इसलिए उसने उन्हें पैसे देने चाहे। \v 19 "मुझे भी यह शक्ति दीजिए," उसने कहा, "ताकि जिस किसी पर मैं हाथ रखूँ, उसे पवित्र आत्मा मिल जाए।"
hi.R: शमौन ने देखा कि जब प्रेरित लोगों पर हाथ रखते हैं, तो उन्हें आत्मा मिल जाता है। इसलिए उसने पतरस और यूहन्ना को पैसे देने चाहे। \v 19 उसने कहा, "मुझे भी यह शक्ति दे दीजिए, ताकि जब मैं किसी पर हाथ रखूँ, तो उसे पवित्र आत्मा मिल जाए।"

ru.L: Увидев же Симон, что через возложение рук апостолов даётся Дух, предложил им деньги, \v 19 говоря: «Дайте и мне эту власть, чтобы тот, на кого я возложу руки, получал Духа Святого.»
ru.B: Симон увидел, что Дух даётся, когда апостолы возлагают на людей руки, и предложил им деньги. \v 19 «Дайте и мне такую силу», — сказал он, — «чтобы каждый, на кого я возложу руки, получал Святого Духа.»
ru.R: Симон увидел, что Дух приходит к людям, когда апостолы кладут на них руки. Поэтому он предложил Петру и Иоанну деньги. \v 19 Он сказал: «Дайте и мне эту силу. Тогда тот, на кого я положу руки, получит Святого Духа.»

uk.L: А Симон, побачивши, що через покладання рук апостолів дається Дух, приніс їм гроші, \v 19 кажучи: «Дайте й мені цю владу, щоб той, на кого я покладу [свої] руки, приймав Святого Духа.»
uk.B: Симон побачив, що Дух дається, коли апостоли покладають на людей руки, і запропонував їм гроші. \v 19 «Дайте й мені цю силу», — сказав він, — «щоб кожен, на кого я покладу руки, приймав Святого Духа.»
uk.R: Симон побачив, що Дух сходить на людей, коли апостоли кладуть на них руки. Тож він запропонував Петрові й Іванові гроші. \v 19 Він сказав: «Дайте й мені цю силу. Тоді, коли я покладу руки на когось, ця людина прийме Святого Духа.»

ja.L: さてシモンは、使徒たちが手を置くことによって霊が与えられるのを見て、彼らに金を差し出し、\v 19 「わたしが手を置く人はだれでも聖霊を受けるように、わたしにもこの権能を与えてください」と言った。
ja.B: シモンは、使徒たちが手を置くと霊が与えられるのを見て、彼らに金を差し出した。\v 19 「わたしにもその力を授けてください」と彼は言った。「わたしが手を置く人がだれでも、聖霊を受けられるように。」
ja.R: シモンは、使徒たちが手を置くと、人々に聖霊が来られるのを見ました。それで、ペトロとヨハネにお金を差し出しました。\v 19 そして、「わたしにもこの力をください。そうすれば、わたしが手を置いた人も、聖霊を受けることができます」と言いました。

decisions.choice: Simon saw: the coming of the Spirit could be seen
decisions.reason: Luke does not describe what Simon saw. At Pentecost the Spirit's coming could be seen and heard (2:33), and in 10:46 people speak in tongues.

decisions.choice: authority: the right and power to do something
decisions.reason: The word is used for the authority Jesus gave the Twelve (Luke 9:1). Simon thinks of it as something that can be passed on for a price.

decisions.choice: he offered money: he tried to buy a spiritual power
alternatives: he offered a gift for the poor
decisions.reason: Magicians in the Greek world sold and bought spells and secret knowledge. Simon's name later gave its name to the buying and selling of church offices.

decisions.choice: power
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "power", since Simon is asking for the ability to give the Spirit, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: Peter and John
decisions.reason: Readable names the apostles who were there.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:Denme|Dadme}}
decisions.reason: Simon speaks to the apostles together, so the plural imperative takes the plural_you span, Latin American "ustedes" form by default and the "vosotros" form as the alternative; every second-person plural in this chapter does the same.

decisions.choice: autoridad (L); poder (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is the right and power to do something (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps the book-wide "autoridad"; Balanced and Readable say "poder", as the English says "power", since Simon wants the ability to give the Spirit.

decisions.choice: mamlaka
decisions.reason: The book-wide word for this right and power (meaning decision m2), kept at every level although the English Balanced and Readable say "power": Simon wants the right to give the Spirit, not a strength of his own, and "uwezo" would suggest ability alone.

decisions.choice: Simon says "tôi" and speaks to the apostles as "các ông" (8:19, 8:24); Peter answers him as "ông" (8:20-23)
decisions.reason: Simon is a well-known man of the city, not yet one the apostles know as a brother; "ông" keeps a stern distance without contempt, unlike the "anh" Peter used for Ananias, a member of the church (5:3).

decisions.choice: Simon speaks to the apostles in 합쇼체 and says "나"; Peter answers him in 해라체 (8:20-23), and Simon replies in 합쇼체 with "저" (8:24)
decisions.reason: Simon asks a favour of men he has seen work wonders, so he is polite, but he bargains as an equal and says "나". After Peter's rebuke he humbles himself and says "저". Peter rebukes him as he did Ananias (5:3).

decisions.choice: "권한" (L), "권능" (B), "능력" (R) for exousia
decisions.reason: Authority is the right and power to do something (meaning decision); the English Balanced and Readable say "power".

decisions.choice: "दीजिए" (आप)
decisions.reason: Simon asks the apostles for something, as a petitioner; he addresses them with the respectful "आप". Peter answers him with "तुम" (8:20-23), as one speaking with authority.

decisions.choice: "владу" (L); "силу" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Exousia is the right and power to do something; Literal keeps the usual "влада", Balanced and Readable say "сила", as the English says "power".

decisions.choice: Simon asks the apostles politely ("与えてください", "授けてください")
decisions.reason: Simon is asking a favour of the apostles, so Japanese gives his request in polite speech, and keeps it so in 8:24. Peter answers him plainly and sternly.
Literal keeps the sense of authority to act (m2); Balanced and Readable say "力", the ability Simon wants, as the English does.

decisions.choice: may your silver go with you to destruction: a curse on Simon and his money
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form used for wishes. Peter calls down ruin on Simon together with his money. In 8:22 he urges him to repent, so the curse is a warning, not a closed door.

decisions.choice: destruction: ruin, perishing before God
decisions.reason: The word is often used of final ruin (Matthew 7:13, Philippians 3:19).

decisions.choice: the gift of God: the Holy Spirit, given freely
alternatives: the power to give the Spirit
decisions.reason: Peter calls the Spirit "the gift" in 2:38, and so does Luke in 10:45 and 11:17. A gift cannot be bought.

decisions.choice: silver: money
decisions.reason: Silver coins were the common money. Simon offered "money" (8:18).

decisions.choice: To ruin with you and your silver!
alternatives: May your silver perish with you
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the curse its force as a short exclamation.

decisions.choice: ¡Que seas destruido junto con tu dinero!
alternatives: ¡Que tú y tu dinero sean destruidos!
decisions.reason: The English "may you and your money both be destroyed" would need a plural verb in Spanish, which would bring in an ustedes/vosotros choice for a single person; making Simon the subject keeps the address in "tú".

decisions.choice: ton argent
decisions.reason: French "argent" means both silver and money, so the one word carries the Greek "silver" and its sense "money" (m4) without a choice between them.

decisions.choice: "món quà của Đức Chúa Trời" for the gift of God
decisions.reason: The gift is the Holy Spirit, given freely (meaning decision), the word Peter used in 2:38; "ân tứ" is kept for gifts the Spirit gives (Romans 1:11).

decisions.choice: "네 은이 너와 함께 망하기를" (L), "네 돈과 함께 너도 망하여라" (B), "망할 것이다" (R); "하나님의 선물"
decisions.reason: A curse on Simon and his money; destruction is ruin before God (meaning decisions). Korean has no optative mood, so Literal says it as a wish and Balanced as a curse; Readable follows the English with a plain statement of what will come.

decisions.choice: a sua prata (L, B); o seu dinheiro (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "prata", the coin metal Peter names, which gives the curse its concrete edge; Readable says "dinheiro", as the English Readable says "money" (m4).

decisions.choice: Que você e a sua prata vão juntos para a ruína!
alternatives: Para a ruína com você e a sua prata!
decisions.reason: The English Balanced makes the wish a short exclamation. Portuguese cannot start with "Para a ruína com..." naturally, so it keeps the wish form "Que ... vão" with an exclamation mark.

decisions.choice: የብር ገንዘብ (L); ገንዘብ (B, R) for 'silver'
decisions.reason: ብር alone now reads as the birr, Ethiopia's currency; Literal says 'silver money', and Balanced and Readable say 'money', which is what the silver is here (m4).
Peter rebukes Simon with "तुम", the address the style guide gives to someone spoken to with authority; "तू" is kept for prayer to God. The same through 8:23.

decisions.choice: "Пропади ты вместе со своим серебром!"
alternatives: серебро твоё да будет в погибель с тобой
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the curse as a short Russian exclamation instead of the Synodal wording.

decisions.choice: Peter's rebuke to Simon in the plain style at every level (8:20-23)
decisions.reason: Peter speaks one to one and sternly, pronouncing a curse and a warning, so the plain style fits at every level; his speeches to crowds and councils are in です・ます.
Literal keeps the Greek word for silver; Balanced and Readable say money, which is what it means here (m4).

am.R: በዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ ውስጥ ስፍራ የለህም። በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ልብህ ቅን አይደለም።

ru.L: Нет тебе ни части, ни доли в этом деле, ведь сердце твоё не право перед Богом.
ru.B: У тебя нет ни части, ни доли в этом, потому что в глазах Бога твоё сердце нечестно.
ru.R: Тебе нет места в этом Божьем деле. Бог видит, что сердце у тебя нечестное.

uk.L: Немає тобі ні частки, ні уділу в цій справі, бо твоє серце не праве перед Богом.
uk.B: Ти не маєш ні частки, ні долі в цьому, бо в Божих очах твоє серце неправе.

ja.L: あなたには、この事に分も割り当てもない。あなたの心は神の前に正しくないからだ。
