decisions.choice: part nor lot: the words used of the Levites, who had no share in the land
decisions.reason: The Greek Old Testament uses the same pair of words in Deuteronomy 12:12 and 14:27. "Lot" is also the word for the place in the ministry that fell to Matthias (1:17, 1:25).

decisions.choice: this matter: this gift and the work it belongs to
decisions.reason: The word can mean "word" or "message", and some read "you have no share in this message". Here it most likely means the matter at hand, the giving of the Spirit.

decisions.choice: your heart is not right before God: the words of Psalm 78:37
decisions.reason: In the Greek of Psalm 78:37 (77:37 in that numbering) Israel's heart was not right with God. The phrase means a heart not true or upright toward God.

decisions.choice: no place in this work of God
alternatives: no part or share in this matter
decisions.reason: Readable puts the two words for a share into one plain phrase.

decisions.choice: porción ni herencia
decisions.reason: The pair echoes what was said of the Levites, who had no share or inheritance in the land (meaning decision m1); "suerte" now suggests luck rather than an allotted share.

decisions.choice: fungu wala urithi
decisions.reason: The pair echoes what was said of the Levites, who had no share or inheritance in the land (meaning decision m1); "bahati" means luck, not an allotted share.

decisions.choice: "몫도 분깃도" (L) for "part nor lot"
decisions.reason: The words used of the Levites, who had no share in the land (meaning decision); "분깃" is the Bible word for an allotted share and keeps that echo at Literal.

decisions.choice: parte nem quinhão
decisions.reason: "Quinhão" is the Portuguese word for an allotted share, an inheritance portion or a share of land, and so keeps the echo of the Levites who had no share in the land (m1). "Sorte" is the old literal word for "lot" but today means luck.

source.text: μετανόησον οὖν ἀπὸ τῆς κακίας σου ταύτης, καὶ δεήθητι τοῦ κυρίου εἰ ἄρα ἀφεθήσεταί σοι ἡ ἐπίνοια τῆς καρδίας σου·

records.literal_gloss: Repent therefore from the wickedness of you this and pray to the Lord, if perhaps will be forgiven you the intent of the heart of you;

en.L: So repent of this wickedness of yours and pray to the Lord, if perhaps the intent of your heart will be forgiven you,
en.B: So turn from this wickedness of yours and pray to the Lord. It may be that he will forgive you for what you had in your heart,
en.R: So stop doing this evil thing and turn back to God. Pray to the Lord. Maybe he will forgive you for what you were planning in your heart.

es.L: Arrepiéntete, pues, de esta maldad tuya, y ruega al Señor, si acaso te será perdonada la intención de tu corazón,
es.B: Así que arrepiéntete de esta maldad tuya y ora al Señor. Puede ser que te perdone lo que tenías en el corazón,
es.R: Así que deja de hacer este mal y vuelve a Dios. Ora al Señor. Tal vez te perdone por lo que estabas planeando en tu corazón.

fr.L: Repens-toi donc de cette méchanceté qui est la tienne, et prie le Seigneur : peut-être l’intention de ton cœur te sera-t-elle pardonnée,
fr.B: Repens-toi donc de cette méchanceté et prie le Seigneur. Il se peut qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te pardonne ce que tu avais dans le cœur,
fr.R: Arrête de faire ce mal et reviens vers Dieu. Prie le Seigneur. Peut-être qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te pardonnera ce que tu préparais dans ton cœur.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, tubu, uache ubaya wako huu, na umsihi Bwana, kama labda utasamehewa kusudi la moyo wako,
sw.B: Basi tubu, uache uovu wako huu, umwombe Bwana. Huenda akakusamehe kwa yale uliyokuwa ukiwaza moyoni,
sw.R: Basi acha kufanya ubaya huu, umrudie Mungu. Mwombe Bwana. Huenda akakusamehe kwa yale uliyokuwa ukipanga moyoni mwako.

vi.L: Vậy hãy ăn năn về sự gian ác này của ông và cầu xin Chúa, may ra ý tưởng trong lòng ông được tha cho ông;
vi.B: Vậy hãy từ bỏ điều gian ác này và cầu xin Chúa. Biết đâu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ tha thứ cho ông về điều ông đã toan tính trong lòng,
vi.R: Vậy hãy ngừng làm điều ác này và quay về với Đức Chúa Trời. Hãy cầu xin Chúa. Biết đâu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ tha thứ cho ông về điều ông đã toan tính trong lòng.

ko.L: 그러므로 너의 이 악함을 회개하고 주님께 기도하여라. 혹시 네 마음에 품은 생각을 용서받을 수 있을지도 모른다.
ko.B: 그러니 이 악한 마음을 회개하고 주님께 기도하여라. 그러면 주님께서 네 마음에 품었던 생각을 용서해 주실지도 모른다.
ko.R: 그러니 이 나쁜 짓을 그만두고 하나님께 돌아오너라. 주님께 기도하여라. 그러면 혹시 주님께서 네가 마음속으로 꾸몄던 일을 용서해 주실지도 모른다.

pt.L: Arrependa-se, pois, desta sua maldade e ore ao Senhor, se porventura lhe será perdoada a intenção do seu coração;
pt.B: Por isso, arrependa-se desta sua maldade e ore ao Senhor. Talvez seja perdoado o que você tinha no coração,
pt.R: Por isso, pare de fazer esse mal e volte-se para Deus. Ore ao Senhor. Talvez o Senhor perdoe você pelo plano que estava no seu coração.

am.L: ስለዚህ ከዚህ ክፋትህ ንስሓ ግባ፤ ምናልባት የልብህ ሐሳብ ይቅር ይባልልህ እንደ ሆነ ጌታን ለምን፤
am.B: ስለዚህ ከዚህ ክፋትህ ንስሓ ግባ፤ ጌታንም ለምን። ምናልባት በልብህ ያሰብከውን ይቅር ይልህ ይሆናል፤
am.R: ስለዚህ ንስሓ ግባ፤ ይህን ክፉ ነገር ትተህ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለስ። ጌታን ለምን። ምናልባት በልብህ ያቀድከውን ይቅር ይልህ ይሆናል።

hi.L: इसलिए अपनी इस बुराई से मन फिराओ और प्रभु से प्रार्थना करो; क्या जाने तुम्हारे मन का यह विचार क्षमा किया जाए,
hi.B: इसलिए अपनी इस बुराई से मन फिराओ और प्रभु से प्रार्थना करो। हो सकता है कि वे तुम्हारे मन की इस बात को क्षमा कर दें,
hi.R: इसलिए यह बुरा काम छोड़ दो और अपने पापों से मुड़कर परमेश्वर की ओर लौट आओ। प्रभु से प्रार्थना करो। हो सकता है कि जो तुमने अपने मन में सोचा था, वे उसे क्षमा कर दें।

ru.L: Итак, покайся в этом нечестии твоём и помолись Господу: может быть, простится тебе замысел сердца твоего,
ru.B: Так покайся в этом своём злом деле и помолись Господу. Может быть, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} простит тебе то, что было у тебя на сердце,
ru.R: Перестань делать это злое дело и вернись к Богу. Помолись Господу. Может быть, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} простит тебе то, что ты задумал в своём сердце.

uk.L: Тож покайся в цьому своєму злі й помолися Господу, чи, може, проститься тобі задум твого серця,
uk.B: Тож відвернися від цього свого зла й помолися Господу. Можливо, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} простить тобі те, що ти задумав у серці,
uk.R: Тож перестань чинити це зло й повернися до Бога. Помолися Господу. Може, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} простить тобі те, що ти задумав у своєму серці.

ja.L: だから、このあなたの悪を悔い改めて、主に祈りなさい。もしかすると、あなたの心の企てが赦されるかもしれない。
ja.B: だから、この悪を悔い改め、主に祈りなさい。もしかすると、主はあなたが心に抱いた企てを赦してくださるかもしれない。
ja.R: だから、この悪い行いをやめて、心を入れ替えて神に立ち返りなさい。主に祈りなさい。もしかすると、主は、あなたが心の中で考えていたことをゆるしてくださるかもしれない。

decisions.choice: repent: turn away from it, change one's mind and ways
decisions.reason: The word means a change of mind that leads to a change of life, as in 2:38 and 3:19.

decisions.choice: if perhaps: forgiveness is not presumed, but it is possible
decisions.reason: The words express real uncertainty about the outcome, but Peter still urges Simon to pray. The doubt lies in Simon's heart, not in God's willingness.

decisions.choice: the Lord: here most likely God
decisions.reason: "Lord" can mean God or Jesus in Acts. Some manuscripts read "God" here. The same Lord is meant in 8:24.

decisions.choice: intent: plan, purpose, what one has in mind
decisions.reason: The word means a thought one has formed or a design. Simon's plan was to buy the Spirit.

decisions.choice: stop doing this evil thing and turn back to God
decisions.reason: Readable explains what it means to repent.

decisions.choice: se repentir (L, B); arrête de faire ce mal et reviens vers Dieu (R)
alternatives: détourne-toi de cette méchanceté (B), as the English "turn from"
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "se repentir" at Literal and Balanced for the whole New Testament; Readable explains it as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} for the Lord who may forgive (and "Demandez-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}" in 8:24)
decisions.reason: The English has no setting on this "he"; the Lord here is most likely God (m3), so French gives the pronoun the deity setting, as it does for every pronoun for God.

decisions.choice: Talvez seja perdoado (B); Talvez o Senhor perdoe (R)
decisions.reason: Portuguese avoids a pronoun for the Lord here: Balanced keeps the Greek passive, Readable names "o Senhor". The English has a plain "he"; a lowercase "ele" for God with no setting span would be out of step with the deity_pronoun setting elsewhere.

decisions.choice: "मन फिराओ" (L, B); "पापों से मुड़कर ... लौट आओ" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's word for repent: "मन फिराना" at Literal and Balanced, "पापों से मुड़ना" at Readable, which also says what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "वे" (honorific)
decisions.reason: The Lord here is most likely God (meaning decision m3), who takes honorific forms when spoken of, as settled in Mark.

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}" for the Lord
decisions.reason: Russian puts every pronoun for God or Christ under the capitalisation setting (style guide section 7), including here, where the English pronoun has no span.

decisions.choice: "悔い改める" (L, B); "この悪い行いをやめて、心を入れ替えて神に立ち返りなさい" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains what it means to repent, as the style guide allows and the English Readable does.

source.text: εἰς γὰρ χολὴν πικρίας καὶ σύνδεσμον ἀδικίας ὁρῶ σε ὄντα.

records.literal_gloss: In for gall of bitterness and bond of unrighteousness I see you being.

en.L: For I see that you are in [the] gall of bitterness and [the] bond of unrighteousness."
en.B: For I can see that you are full of bitter poison and bound by wrongdoing."
en.R: I can see that you are full of bitter jealousy. You are a prisoner of your sin."

es.L: Porque veo que estás en [la] hiel de amargura y [en el] lazo de injusticia».
es.B: Porque veo que estás lleno de veneno amargo y atado por la maldad».
es.R: Puedo ver que estás lleno de celos amargos. Eres prisionero de tu pecado».

fr.L: Car je vois que tu es dans le fiel de l’amertume et le lien de l’injustice. »
fr.B: Car je le vois : tu es rempli d’un poison amer et prisonnier du mal. »
fr.R: Je vois que tu es plein d’une jalousie amère. Tu es prisonnier de ton péché. »

sw.L: Kwa maana naona kwamba umo katika nyongo ya uchungu na katika pingu za udhalimu."
sw.B: Kwa maana naona kwamba umejaa sumu chungu, na umefungwa na uovu."
sw.R: Naona kwamba umejaa wivu mchungu. Wewe ni mfungwa wa dhambi yako."

vi.L: vì tôi thấy ông đang ở trong mật đắng cay và trong xiềng xích của sự gian ác."
vi.B: vì tôi thấy ông đầy chất độc cay đắng và bị trói buộc bởi điều sai trái."
vi.R: Tôi thấy ông đầy lòng ghen tức cay đắng. Ông đang là tù nhân của tội lỗi mình."

ko.L: 내가 보니 너는 쓴 독에 빠져 있고 불의에 매여 있다."
ko.B: 내가 보니 너는 쓰디쓴 독이 가득하고 불의에 꽁꽁 묶여 있다."
ko.R: 내가 보니 너는 쓰라린 시기심으로 가득 차 있다. 너는 네 죄에 갇혀 있다."

pt.L: Pois vejo que você está no fel da amargura e nos laços da injustiça."
pt.B: Pois posso ver que você está cheio de veneno amargo e preso pela maldade."
pt.R: Eu vejo que você está cheio de inveja amarga. Você é prisioneiro do seu pecado."

am.L: በመራራ ሐሞትና በዓመፅ እስራት ውስጥ እንዳለህ አያለሁና።»
am.B: በመራራ መርዝ እንደ ተሞላህና በክፋት እንደ ታሰርክ አያለሁና።»
am.R: በመራራ ቅናት እንደ ተሞላህ አያለሁ። የኃጢአትህ እስረኛ ሆነሃል።»

hi.L: क्योंकि मैं देखता हूँ कि तुम कड़वाहट के पित्त और अधर्म के बंधन में पड़े हो।"
hi.B: क्योंकि मैं देख रहा हूँ कि तुम कड़वे विष से भरे हो और बुराई के बंधन में जकड़े हुए हो।"
hi.R: मैं देख सकता हूँ कि तुम्हारे मन में कड़वी जलन भरी है। तुम अपने पाप के क़ैदी हो।"

ru.L: Ведь в желчи горечи и в узах неправды вижу тебя находящимся.»
ru.B: Я же вижу, что ты полон горького яда и связан неправдой.»
ru.R: Я вижу, что ты полон горькой зависти. Ты в плену у своего греха.»

uk.L: Бо я бачу, що ти в жовчі гіркоти та в путах неправедності.»
uk.B: Бо я бачу, що ти сповнений гіркої отрути й скутий злочинством.»
uk.R: Я бачу, що ти сповнений гіркої заздрості. Ти — вʼязень свого гріха.»

ja.L: わたしには、あなたが苦みの胆汁と不義のなわめの中にいるのが見えるからだ。」
ja.B: あなたが苦い毒に満ち、悪に縛られているのが、わたしにはわかる。」
ja.R: あなたは、ひどいねたみでいっぱいになっている。罪のとりこになっているのだ。わたしにはそれがわかる。」

decisions.choice: gall of bitterness: bitter poison, a root of evil, as in Deuteronomy 29:18
decisions.reason: Gall was a bitter, poisonous herb. In the Greek of Deuteronomy 29:18 (29:17 in that numbering) Moses warns against anyone whose heart turns from God, a root bearing gall and bitterness. Hebrews 12:15 uses the same picture.

decisions.choice: bond of unrighteousness: held captive by wrongdoing
alternatives: himself a bond that holds others
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean that Simon is bound by sin, or that he is a bundle of wrongdoing. Isaiah 58:6 in Greek uses the same words for bonds of injustice to be loosed.

decisions.choice: you are in: the phrase describes the state Simon is in
decisions.reason: The preposition with "being" describes a state. Some read it as Simon's coming destiny, but the verb "I see" speaks of the present.

decisions.choice: bitter jealousy
decisions.reason: Readable names the bitterness Simon shows, the wish to have what the apostles had. It explains the picture rather than keeping it.

decisions.choice: a prisoner of your sin
decisions.reason: Readable follows the reading that Simon is bound by sin.

decisions.choice: "mật đắng cay" (L); "chất độc cay đắng" (B) for the gall of bitterness
decisions.reason: Bitter poison, a root of evil, as in Deuteronomy 29:18 (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "쓴 독" (L), "쓰디쓴 독" (B); "불의에 매여 있다"
decisions.reason: Gall of bitterness is bitter poison, a root of evil, as in Deuteronomy 29:18; the bond of unrighteousness holds him captive (meaning decisions). Korean keeps the two pictures.

decisions.choice: "苦みの胆汁", "不義のなわめ" (L); "苦い毒", "悪に縛られている" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of gall, the bitter poisonous herb of Deuteronomy 29:18 (m1), and of a bond. Balanced says what gall is, bitter poison, and follows the reading that Simon is bound by wrongdoing (m2).

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Σίμων εἶπεν· Δεήθητε ὑμεῖς ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ πρὸς τὸν κύριον ὅπως μηδὲν ἐπέλθῃ ἐπ’ ἐμὲ ὧν εἰρήκατε.

records.literal_gloss: Answering now the Simon said, Pray you on behalf of me to the Lord, so that nothing may come upon me of which you have spoken.

en.L: And Simon answered and said, "You pray to the Lord on my behalf, so that nothing of what you have spoken may come upon me."
en.B: Simon replied, "Pray to the Lord for me yourselves, so that none of the things you have said will happen to me."
en.R: Simon answered, "Please pray to the Lord for me. Ask him not to let these terrible things happen to me."

es.L: Y respondiendo Simón, dijo: «{{plural_you:Rueguen ustedes|Rogad vosotros}} por mí al Señor, para que no venga sobre mí nada de lo que {{plural_you:han dicho|habéis dicho}}».
es.B: Simón respondió: «{{plural_you:Oren ustedes|Orad vosotros}} al Señor por mí, para que no me suceda nada de lo que {{plural_you:han dicho|habéis dicho}}».
es.R: Simón respondió: «Por favor, {{plural_you:oren|orad}} al Señor por mí. {{plural_you:Pídanle|Pedidle}} que no deje que me pasen estas cosas terribles».

fr.L: Et Simon, répondant, dit : « Vous, priez le Seigneur pour moi, afin que rien de ce que vous avez dit ne vienne sur moi. »
fr.B: Simon répondit : « Priez vous-mêmes le Seigneur pour moi, afin que rien de ce que vous avez dit ne m’arrive. »
fr.R: Simon a répondu : « S’il vous plaît, priez le Seigneur pour moi. Demandez-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} de ne pas laisser ces choses terribles m’arriver. »

sw.L: Na Simoni akajibu, akasema, "Niombeeni ninyi kwa Bwana, ili lisinijie hata moja la mambo mliyoyasema."
sw.B: Simoni akajibu, "Ninyi wenyewe mniombee kwa Bwana, ili nisipatwe na lolote kati ya mambo mliyosema."
sw.R: Simoni akajibu, "Tafadhali niombeeni kwa Bwana. Mwombeni asiruhusu mambo haya mabaya sana yanipate."

vi.L: Si-môn trả lời: "Chính các ông hãy cầu xin Chúa cho tôi, để không điều nào các ông đã nói xảy đến cho tôi."
vi.B: Si-môn đáp: "Xin chính các ông cầu xin Chúa cho tôi, để không điều nào các ông vừa nói xảy đến cho tôi."
vi.R: Si-môn trả lời: "Xin các ông cầu xin Chúa cho tôi. Xin Chúa đừng để những điều khủng khiếp ấy xảy đến cho tôi."

ko.L: 그러자 시몬이 대답하여 말했다. "여러분이 저를 위하여 주님께 기도해 주십시오. 여러분이 말한 일이 하나도 저에게 일어나지 않게 해 주십시오."
ko.B: 시몬이 대답했다. "여러분이 저를 위하여 주님께 기도해 주십시오. 말씀하신 일이 하나도 저에게 일어나지 않게 해 주십시오."
ko.R: 시몬이 대답했다. "저를 위하여 주님께 기도해 주십시오. 그런 끔찍한 일이 저에게 일어나지 않게 해 달라고 구해 주십시오."

pt.L: E, respondendo, Simão disse: "Orem vocês ao Senhor por mim, para que nada do que vocês disseram venha sobre mim."
pt.B: Simão respondeu: "Orem vocês mesmos ao Senhor por mim, para que nada do que disseram aconteça comigo."
pt.R: Simão respondeu: "Por favor, orem por mim. Peçam ao Senhor que não deixe essas coisas terríveis acontecerem comigo."

am.L: ስምዖንም መልሶ፦ «ከተናገራችሁት ምንም እንዳይደርስብኝ እናንተ ስለ እኔ ወደ ጌታ ጸልዩልኝ» አለ።
am.B: ስምዖንም፦ «ከተናገራችሁት ነገር አንዱም እንዳይደርስብኝ እናንተው ራሳችሁ ስለ እኔ ወደ ጌታ ጸልዩ» ብሎ መለሰ።
am.R: ስምዖንም፦ «እባካችሁ ስለ እኔ ወደ ጌታ ጸልዩልኝ። እነዚህ አስከፊ ነገሮች እንዳይደርሱብኝ ለምኑልኝ» ብሎ መለሰ።

hi.L: शमौन ने उत्तर दिया, "आप ही मेरे लिए प्रभु से प्रार्थना कीजिए कि जो बातें आपने कहीं, उनमें से कोई मुझ पर न आ पड़े।"
hi.B: शमौन ने उत्तर दिया, "आप स्वयं मेरे लिए प्रभु से प्रार्थना कीजिए, ताकि जो कुछ आपने कहा है, उसमें से कुछ भी मुझ पर न बीते।"
hi.R: शमौन ने कहा, "कृपया मेरे लिए प्रभु से प्रार्थना कीजिए। उनसे माँगिए कि ये भयानक बातें मेरे साथ न होने दें।"

ru.L: Отвечая же, Симон сказал: «Помолитесь вы за меня Господу, чтобы ничего не постигло меня из того, о чём вы сказали.»
ru.B: Симон ответил: «Помолитесь сами Господу за меня, чтобы со мной не случилось ничего из того, о чём вы сказали.»
ru.R: Симон ответил: «Пожалуйста, помолитесь Господу за меня. Попросите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, чтобы со мной не случилось этих страшных вещей.»

uk.L: А Симон, відповідаючи, сказав: «Помоліться ви за мене до Господа, щоб ніщо з того, що ви сказали, не спіткало мене.»
uk.B: Симон відповів: «Помоліться ви самі за мене до Господа, щоб ніщо з того, про що ви сказали, не сталося зі мною.»
uk.R: Симон відповів: «Будь ласка, помоліться за мене Господу. Попросіть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, щоб ці страшні речі не сталися зі мною.»

ja.L: そこでシモンは答えて言った。「あなたがたが言ったことが何一つわたしに降りかからないように、あなたがたこそ、わたしのために主に祈ってください。」
ja.B: シモンは答えた。「どうか、あなたがたのほうで、わたしのために主に祈ってください。今言われたことが何一つ、わたしの身に起こらないように。」
ja.R: シモンは答えました。「どうか、わたしのために主に祈ってください。そんな恐ろしいことがわたしに起こらないように、主にお願いしてください。」

decisions.choice: you pray: Simon asks the apostles to pray, rather than praying himself
decisions.reason: Peter told Simon to pray (8:22). Simon answers with the plural pronoun stressed: you pray for me. Luke does not tell what became of him.

decisions.choice: what you have spoken: the destruction Peter spoke of in 8:20
decisions.reason: Simon fears the curse, not the sin Peter named.

decisions.choice: these terrible things
decisions.reason: Readable sums up what Peter had said would happen.

source.text: Οἱ μὲν οὖν διαμαρτυράμενοι καὶ λαλήσαντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ κυρίου ὑπέστρεφον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, πολλάς τε κώμας τῶν Σαμαριτῶν εὐηγγελίζοντο.

records.literal_gloss: They indeed therefore having testified and having spoken the word of the Lord were returning to Jerusalem, many and villages of the Samaritans they were proclaiming the good news.

en.L: So they, having testified and spoken the word of the Lord, were returning to Jerusalem, and they were proclaiming the good news to many villages of the Samaritans.
en.B: After Peter and John had borne witness and spoken the word of the Lord, they set out back to Jerusalem, announcing the good news in many Samaritan villages on the way.
en.R: Peter and John told people what they knew about Jesus, and they spoke the word of the Lord. Then they went back to Jerusalem. On the way they told the good news in many villages in Samaria.

es.L: Ellos, pues, habiendo testificado y hablado la palabra del Señor, regresaban a Jerusalén, y anunciaban la buena noticia a muchas aldeas de los samaritanos.
es.B: Después de dar testimonio y de hablar la palabra del Señor, Pedro y Juan emprendieron el regreso a Jerusalén, y por el camino anunciaron la buena noticia en muchas aldeas samaritanas.
es.R: Pedro y Juan le contaron a la gente lo que sabían de Jesús, y hablaron la palabra del Señor. Luego regresaron a Jerusalén. En el camino contaron la buena noticia en muchas aldeas de Samaria.

fr.L: Eux donc, ayant rendu témoignage et ayant annoncé la parole du Seigneur, retournaient à Jérusalem, et ils annonçaient la bonne nouvelle à beaucoup de villages des Samaritains.
fr.B: Après avoir rendu témoignage et annoncé la parole du Seigneur, Pierre et Jean reprirent le chemin de Jérusalem, en annonçant la bonne nouvelle dans de nombreux villages samaritains.
fr.R: Pierre et Jean ont dit aux gens ce qu’ils savaient de Jésus, et ils ont annoncé la parole du Seigneur. Puis ils sont repartis vers Jérusalem. En chemin, ils ont annoncé la bonne nouvelle dans beaucoup de villages de Samarie.

sw.L: Basi wao, wakiisha kushuhudia na kulinena neno la Bwana, walikuwa wakirudi Yerusalemu, na walikuwa wakihubiri habari njema katika vijiji vingi vya Wasamaria.
sw.B: Petro na Yohana walipokwisha kushuhudia na kulinena neno la Bwana, walianza safari ya kurudi Yerusalemu, wakihubiri habari njema njiani katika vijiji vingi vya Wasamaria.
sw.R: Petro na Yohana waliwaeleza watu yale waliyoyajua kuhusu Yesu, na walinena neno la Bwana. Kisha wakarudi Yerusalemu. Njiani walihubiri habari njema katika vijiji vingi vya Samaria.

vi.L: Vậy sau khi đã làm chứng và rao truyền lời Chúa, hai ông trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem, vừa đi vừa rao giảng Tin Lành tại nhiều làng của người Sa-ma-ri.
vi.B: Sau khi đã làm chứng và rao truyền lời Chúa, Phi-e-rơ và Giăng lên đường trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem, dọc đường rao giảng Tin Lành tại nhiều làng của người Sa-ma-ri.
vi.R: Phi-e-rơ và Giăng nói cho dân chúng biết những gì hai ông biết về Đức Giê-xu, và hai ông rao truyền lời Chúa. Rồi hai ông trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem. Trên đường đi, hai ông nói Tin Lành tại nhiều làng ở miền Sa-ma-ri.

ko.L: 그래서 그들은 엄숙히 증언하고 주님의 말씀을 전한 뒤에 예루살렘으로 돌아가면서, 사마리아 사람들의 여러 마을에서 복음을 전했다.
ko.B: 베드로와 요한은 주님의 말씀을 증언하고 전한 뒤에, 예루살렘으로 돌아가면서 사마리아 사람들의 여러 마을에 복음을 전했다.
ko.R: 베드로와 요한은 예수에 관하여 아는 것을 사람들에게 이야기했다. 그리고 주님의 말씀을 전했다. 그런 다음 예루살렘으로 돌아갔다. 돌아가는 길에 그들은 사마리아의 여러 마을에서 기쁜 소식을 전했다.

pt.L: Eles, então, tendo testemunhado e falado a palavra do Senhor, voltavam para Jerusalém, e anunciavam as boas-novas a muitos povoados dos samaritanos.
pt.B: Depois de darem testemunho e anunciarem a palavra do Senhor, Pedro e João tomaram o caminho de volta para Jerusalém e, no trajeto, anunciaram as boas-novas em muitos povoados samaritanos.
pt.R: Pedro e João contaram ao povo o que sabiam sobre Jesus e falaram a palavra do Senhor. Depois voltaram para Jerusalém. No caminho, contaram as boas-novas em muitos povoados de Samaria.

am.L: እነርሱም መስክረው የጌታንም ቃል ተናግረው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይመለሱ ነበር፤ ለብዙ የሳምራውያን መንደሮችም ወንጌልን ይሰብኩ ነበር።
am.B: ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ ከመሰከሩና የጌታን ቃል ከተናገሩ በኋላ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፤ በመንገዳቸውም በብዙ የሳምራውያን መንደሮች ወንጌልን አበሠሩ።
am.R: ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ ስለ ኢየሱስ የሚያውቁትን ለሰዎች መሰከሩ፤ የጌታንም ቃል ተናገሩ። ከዚያም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ። በመንገድም በሰማርያ በሚገኙ ብዙ መንደሮች የምሥራቹን ነገሩ።

hi.L: तब वे गवाही देकर और प्रभु का वचन सुनाकर यरूशलेम को लौटे, और सामरियों के बहुत-से गाँवों में सुसमाचार सुनाते गए।
hi.B: पतरस और यूहन्ना गवाही देकर और प्रभु का वचन सुनाकर यरूशलेम की ओर लौट चले, और रास्ते में सामरियों के बहुत-से गाँवों में सुसमाचार सुनाते गए।
hi.R: पतरस और यूहन्ना ने लोगों को वह सब बताया जो वे यीशु के बारे में जानते थे, और प्रभु का वचन सुनाया। फिर वे यरूशलेम लौट गए। रास्ते में उन्होंने सामरिया के बहुत-से गाँवों में सुसमाचार सुनाया।

ru.L: Они же, засвидетельствовав и сказав слово Господа, возвращались в Иерусалим и во многих селениях самаритян благовествовали.
ru.B: Пётр и Иоанн, засвидетельствовав и возвестив слово Господа, отправились обратно в Иерусалим и по пути возвещали Радостную весть во многих самарийских селениях.
ru.R: Пётр и Иоанн рассказали людям то, что они знали об Иисусе, и говорили им слово Господа. Потом они пошли обратно в Иерусалим. По дороге они рассказывали Радостную весть во многих селениях Самарии.

uk.L: Тож вони, засвідчивши й проговоривши слово Господнє, поверталися до Єрусалима, і благовістили багатьом селам самарян.
uk.B: Петро й Іван, засвідчивши й проголосивши слово Господнє, вирушили назад до Єрусалима, по дорозі звіщаючи Добру звістку в багатьох самарянських селах.
uk.R: Петро й Іван розповіли людям те, що знали про Ісуса, і проголосили слово Господа. Потім вони повернулися до Єрусалима. По дорозі вони розповідали Добру звістку в багатьох селах Самарії.

ja.L: さて、彼らは証しをし、主の言葉を語ってから、エルサレムへ帰って行き、またサマリア人の多くの村々に福音を告げ知らせていった。
ja.B: ペトロとヨハネは、力強く証しをして主の言葉を語った後、エルサレムへの帰途につき、途中、サマリア人の多くの村で福音を告げ知らせた。
ja.R: ペトロとヨハネは、イエスについて自分たちが知っていることを人々に話し、主の言葉を語りました。それから、エルサレムに帰って行きました。帰る途中、サマリアの多くの村で良い知らせを伝えました。

decisions.choice: having testified: having borne solemn witness
decisions.reason: The verb means to bear witness earnestly, as in 2:40. It recalls Jesus's word that his followers would be his witnesses in Samaria (1:8).

decisions.choice: they: Peter and John
decisions.reason: The sentence follows the account of Peter and John. Philip is sent on a different road in the next sentence.

decisions.choice: villages of the Samaritans: the same people John once wanted to destroy
decisions.reason: When a Samaritan village refused Jesus, James and John asked to call fire down on it (Luke 9:52-55). Now John brings the good news to Samaritan villages.

decisions.choice: Peter and John
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the subject, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: told people what they knew about Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable says what bearing witness means.

source.text: Ἄγγελος δὲ κυρίου ἐλάλησεν πρὸς Φίλιππον λέγων· Ἀνάστηθι καὶ πορεύου κατὰ μεσημβρίαν ἐπὶ τὴν ὁδὸν τὴν καταβαίνουσαν ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλὴμ εἰς Γάζαν· αὕτη ἐστὶν ἔρημος.

records.literal_gloss: An angel now of Lord spoke to Philip saying, Rise and go toward south on the road that going down from Jerusalem to Gaza; this is desert.

en.L: Now an angel of [the] Lord spoke to Philip, saying, "Get up and go toward [the] south, to the road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza." This is desert.
en.B: An angel of the Lord said to Philip, "Get ready and head south, to the road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza." (This is a desert road.)
en.R: An angel from the Lord spoke to Philip. He said, "Get up and go south. Go to the road that leads down from Jerusalem to the town of Gaza." (That road goes through the desert.)

es.L: Y un ángel del Señor habló a Felipe, diciendo: «Levántate y ve hacia [el] sur, al camino que desciende de Jerusalén a Gaza». Esto es desierto.
es.B: Un ángel del Señor le dijo a Felipe: «Prepárate y ve hacia el sur, al camino que baja de Jerusalén a Gaza». (Es un camino que pasa por el desierto).
es.R: Un ángel del Señor le habló a Felipe. Le dijo: «Levántate y ve hacia el sur. Ve al camino que baja de Jerusalén al pueblo de Gaza». (Ese camino pasa por el desierto).

fr.L: Or un ange du Seigneur parla à Philippe, disant : « Lève-toi et va vers le midi, sur la route qui descend de Jérusalem à Gaza. » Elle est déserte.
fr.B: Un ange du Seigneur dit à Philippe : « Prépare-toi et pars vers le sud, sur la route qui descend de Jérusalem à Gaza. » (C’est une route déserte.)
fr.R: Un ange envoyé par le Seigneur a parlé à Philippe. Il lui a dit : « Lève-toi et va vers le sud. Va sur la route qui descend de Jérusalem jusqu’à la ville de Gaza. » (Cette route traverse le désert.)

sw.L: Na malaika wa Bwana alisema na Filipo, akisema, "Inuka, uende upande wa kusini, kwenye njia ishukayo kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda Gaza." Hii ni nyika.
sw.B: Malaika wa Bwana alimwambia Filipo, "Jiandae, uende upande wa kusini, kwenye njia inayoshuka kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda Gaza." (Hii ni njia ya nyikani.)
sw.R: Malaika wa Bwana alizungumza na Filipo. Akamwambia, "Inuka uende kusini. Nenda kwenye njia inayoshuka kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda mji wa Gaza." (Njia hiyo inapita jangwani.)

vi.L: Bấy giờ một thiên sứ của Chúa nói với Phi-líp: "Hãy đứng dậy đi về phía nam, đến con đường từ Giê-ru-sa-lem xuống Ga-xa." Đường ấy vắng vẻ.
vi.B: Một thiên sứ của Chúa nói với Phi-líp: "Ông hãy chuẩn bị đi về phía nam, đến con đường từ Giê-ru-sa-lem xuống Ga-xa." (Đó là con đường vắng vẻ.)
vi.R: Một thiên sứ của Chúa nói với Phi-líp: "Ông hãy đứng dậy đi về phía nam. Hãy đến con đường từ Giê-ru-sa-lem xuống thị trấn Ga-xa." (Con đường ấy đi qua sa mạc.)

ko.L: 그런데 주님의 천사가 빌립에게 말했다. "일어나서 남쪽으로, 예루살렘에서 가사로 내려가는 길로 가거라." 그 길은 광야이다.
ko.B: 주님의 천사가 빌립에게 말했다. "일어나서 남쪽으로 가거라. 예루살렘에서 가사로 내려가는 길로 가거라." 그 길은 광야로 나 있는 길이다.
ko.R: 주님께서 보내신 천사가 빌립에게 말했다. "일어나서 남쪽으로 가거라. 예루살렘에서 가사라는 마을로 내려가는 길로 가거라." 그 길은 광야를 지나간다.

pt.L: E um anjo do Senhor falou a Filipe, dizendo: "Levante-se e vá em direção ao sul, à estrada que desce de Jerusalém a Gaza." Esta é deserta.
pt.B: Um anjo do Senhor disse a Filipe: "Prepare-se e vá para o sul, até a estrada que desce de Jerusalém para Gaza." (É uma estrada deserta.)
pt.R: Um anjo enviado pelo Senhor falou com Filipe. Ele disse: "Levante-se e vá para o sul. Vá até a estrada que desce de Jerusalém para a cidade de Gaza." (Essa estrada atravessa o deserto.)

am.L: የጌታም መልአክ ፊልጶስን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው፦ «ተነሥተህ ወደ ደቡብ፣ ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ጋዛ ወደሚወርደው መንገድ ሂድ።» ይህም ምድረ በዳ ነው።
am.B: የጌታ መልአክ ፊልጶስን፦ «ተዘጋጅተህ ወደ ደቡብ፣ ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ጋዛ ወደሚወርደው መንገድ ሂድ» አለው። (ይህ መንገድ የበረሃ መንገድ ነው።)
am.R: ከጌታ የተላከ መልአክ ፊልጶስን አነጋገረው። እንዲህም አለው፦ «ተነሥና ወደ ደቡብ ሂድ። ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ጋዛ ከተማ ወደሚወርደው መንገድ ሂድ።» (ያ መንገድ በበረሃ ውስጥ ያልፋል።)

hi.L: फिर प्रभु के एक स्वर्गदूत ने फिलिप्पुस से कहा, "उठो, और दक्षिण की ओर उस मार्ग पर जाओ जो यरूशलेम से गाज़ा को जाता है।" यह निर्जन है।
hi.B: प्रभु के एक स्वर्गदूत ने फिलिप्पुस से कहा, "तैयार हो जाओ और दक्षिण की ओर उस मार्ग पर जाओ जो यरूशलेम से गाज़ा को जाता है।" (यह मार्ग निर्जन प्रदेश से होकर जाता है।)
hi.R: प्रभु की ओर से एक स्वर्गदूत ने फिलिप्पुस से बात की। उसने कहा, "उठो और दक्षिण की ओर जाओ। उस सड़क पर जाओ जो यरूशलेम से गाज़ा नगर की ओर नीचे जाती है।" (वह सड़क सुनसान इलाक़े से होकर जाती थी।)

ru.L: Ангел же Господа сказал Филиппу, говоря: «Встань и иди к югу, на дорогу, спускающуюся из Иерусалима в Газу.» Это — пустыня.
ru.B: Ангел Господа сказал Филиппу: «Собирайся и иди на юг, к дороге, которая спускается из Иерусалима в Газу.» (Это пустынная дорога.)
ru.R: Ангел от Господа заговорил с Филиппом. Он сказал: «Встань и иди на юг. Иди к дороге, которая ведёт из Иерусалима вниз, в город Газу.» (Эта дорога идёт через пустыню.)

uk.L: А ангел Господній заговорив до Филипа, кажучи: «Встань і йди на південь, на дорогу, що спускається з Єрусалима до Гази.» Вона пустельна.
uk.B: Ангел Господній сказав Филипові: «Збирайся й іди на південь, на дорогу, що веде з Єрусалима вниз до Гази.» (Це пустельна дорога.)
uk.R: Ангел від Господа заговорив до Филипа. Він сказав: «Вставай і йди на південь. Іди на дорогу, що веде з Єрусалима вниз до міста Гази.» (Ця дорога йде через пустелю.)

ja.L: さて、主の天使がフィリポに語りかけて言った。「立ち上がって、南の方へ、エルサレムからガザへ下って行く道に行きなさい。」そこは荒れ野である。
ja.B: 主の天使がフィリポに言った。「さあ、南へ向かい、エルサレムからガザへ下る道に行きなさい。」（これは荒れ野を通る道である。）
ja.R: 主から遣わされた天使がフィリポに話しかけました。「立って、南へ行きなさい。エルサレムからガザの町へ下って行く道に行きなさい。」（その道は荒れ野を通っていました。）

decisions.choice: toward the south: the direction Philip should take
decisions.reason: The word means midday, and so also the south, where the sun stands at noon. In 22:6 it means noon. Here, with a road to follow, the direction is more likely. But a journey at noon, in the heat when few would travel, is possible.

decisions.choice: this is desert: most likely the road, which ran through lonely country
decisions.reason: "This" may point to the road or to Gaza. The old city of Gaza had been destroyed in the century before and a new city built nearby, so the words could mean the old Gaza that lay deserted. But the sentence is about the road Philip is to take, and "desert" in the sense of a lonely, empty place fits it.

decisions.choice: this is desert: a comment by Luke for his readers
decisions.reason: The words explain where the road ran. They may be the angel's, but they read more like the narrator's note.

decisions.choice: Gaza: the last town on the road south to Egypt
decisions.reason: Gaza lay near the coast in the southwest, on the route from Judea down to Egypt and on to lands further south.

decisions.choice: a desert road (B); that road goes through the desert (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the reading that "this" is the road, as the meaning note explains, and put the narrator's note in parentheses.

decisions.choice: the town of Gaza
decisions.reason: Readable says that Gaza was a town.

decisions.choice: vers le midi; Elle est déserte
alternatives: vers le sud; Cette route est déserte
decisions.reason: Literal keeps both open readings: "le midi" can be the south or noon (m1), and since "la route" and "Gaza" are both feminine in French, "Elle" can point to either, as the Greek pronoun can (m2). Balanced and Readable follow the reading in the meaning notes.

decisions.choice: nyika (L, B); jangwa (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording: "nyika" is open, empty wild country, the lonely land the road ran through (meaning decision m2); Readable uses the everyday "jangwa", as the English Readable says "desert".

decisions.choice: "Đường ấy vắng vẻ" (L, B) for "this is desert"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the road, which ran through lonely country, so Vietnamese names the road; the angel speaks to Philip as "ông", as in 5:20.

decisions.choice: "가사"; "그 길은 광야이다" (L), "광야로 나 있는 길" (B), "광야를 지나간다" (R)
decisions.reason: "가사" is the Protestant form of Gaza (style guide, Settled). The desert is most likely the road, which ran through lonely country, and it is Luke's comment (meaning decisions); Korean puts it outside the angel's words, as the English does.

decisions.choice: a estrada ... Esta é deserta
decisions.reason: The Greek "this" is feminine and may point to the road or to Gaza (m2). Portuguese "estrada" and "Gaza" are both feminine, so "Esta é deserta" keeps the same open reference at Literal, where "caminho" would decide for Gaza. Balanced and Readable follow the English reading that the road is meant.

decisions.choice: "निर्जन प्रदेश" (B); "सुनसान इलाक़ा" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's words for wilderness, not "जंगल" (forest); the place is lonely country, not sand desert.

decisions.choice: "ガザ"; the desert "荒れ野"
decisions.reason: The town's name is given in the usual Japanese form from the Greek. "荒れ野" is the lonely, empty country of m2; Balanced and Readable follow the reading that the note is about the road and put it in full-width parentheses, as the English does.

source.text: καὶ ἀναστὰς ἐπορεύθη, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ Αἰθίοψ εὐνοῦχος δυνάστης Κανδάκης βασιλίσσης Αἰθιόπων, ὃς ἦν ἐπὶ πάσης τῆς γάζης αὐτῆς, ὃς ἐληλύθει προσκυνήσων εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, ἦν τε ὑποστρέφων καὶ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τοῦ ἅρματος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνεγίνωσκεν τὸν προφήτην Ἠσαΐαν.

records.literal_gloss: And having risen he went; and behold, a man Ethiopian, a eunuch, an official of Candace queen of Ethiopians, who was over all the treasure of her, who had come to worship to Jerusalem, \v 28 was and returning and sitting in the chariot of him and he was reading the prophet Isaiah.

en.L: And he got up and went. And look, an Ethiopian man, a eunuch, an official of Candace, queen of [the] Ethiopians, who was over all her treasury, who had come to Jerusalem to worship, \v 28 was returning and sitting in his chariot, and he was reading the prophet Isaiah.
en.B: So Philip got up and went. And there on the road was a man from Ethiopia, a eunuch, a high official in charge of all the treasury of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians. He had come to Jerusalem to worship, \v 28 and now he was on his way home, seated in his chariot and reading the prophet Isaiah.
en.R: So Philip got up and went. On the road he saw an important man from Ethiopia, a land in Africa south of Egypt. He was a eunuch, a man who served the queen of Ethiopia. The queen was called the Candace, and this man took care of all her money. He had gone to Jerusalem to worship God. \v 28 Now he was going back home. He was sitting in his chariot and reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.

es.L: Y levantándose, fue. Y mira, un hombre etíope, eunuco, funcionario de Candace, reina de [los] etíopes, que estaba a cargo de todo su tesoro, que había venido a Jerusalén para adorar, \v 28 estaba regresando y sentado en su carruaje, y leía al profeta Isaías.
es.B: Así que Felipe se levantó y se fue. Y allí, en el camino, había un hombre de Etiopía, un eunuco, alto funcionario encargado de todo el tesoro de Candace, reina de los etíopes. Había ido a Jerusalén a adorar, \v 28 y ahora volvía a su tierra sentado en su carruaje, leyendo al profeta Isaías.
es.R: Felipe se levantó y fue. En el camino vio a un hombre importante de Etiopía, un país de África al sur de Egipto. Era eunuco, un hombre que servía a la reina de Etiopía. A la reina la llamaban la Candace, y este hombre se encargaba de todo su dinero. Había ido a Jerusalén a adorar a Dios. \v 28 Ahora volvía a su casa. Iba sentado en su carruaje y leía el libro del profeta Isaías.

fr.L: Et, s’étant levé, il partit. Et voici, un homme éthiopien, un eunuque, haut fonctionnaire de Candace, reine des Éthiopiens, qui était [préposé] à tout son trésor, qui était venu à Jérusalem pour adorer, \v 28 était sur le retour, assis dans son char, et il lisait le prophète Isaïe.
fr.B: Philippe se leva donc et partit. Et justement, sur la route, se trouvait un Éthiopien, un eunuque, haut fonctionnaire chargé de tout le trésor de Candace, reine des Éthiopiens. Il était venu à Jérusalem pour adorer, \v 28 et maintenant il rentrait chez lui, assis dans son char, en lisant le prophète Isaïe.
fr.R: Philippe s’est donc levé et il est parti. Sur la route, il a vu un homme important qui venait d’Éthiopie, un pays d’Afrique au sud de l’Égypte. C’était un eunuque, un homme au service de la reine d’Éthiopie. On appelait la reine « la Candace », et cet homme s’occupait de tout son argent. Il était allé à Jérusalem pour adorer Dieu. \v 28 Maintenant, il rentrait chez lui. Il était assis dans son char et il lisait le livre du prophète Isaïe.

sw.L: Na akiinuka, akaenda. Na tazama, mtu Mwethiopia, towashi, afisa wa Kandake malkia wa Waethiopia, aliyekuwa msimamizi wa hazina yake yote, aliyekuwa amekuja Yerusalemu kuabudu, \v 28 alikuwa akirudi, akiwa ameketi katika gari lake, na alikuwa akisoma [kitabu cha] nabii Isaya.
sw.B: Basi Filipo aliinuka, akaenda. Na huko njiani palikuwa na mtu kutoka Ethiopia, towashi, afisa mkuu aliyesimamia hazina yote ya Kandake, malkia wa Waethiopia. Alikuwa amekwenda Yerusalemu kuabudu, \v 28 na sasa alikuwa akirudi nyumbani, ameketi katika gari lake la farasi, akisoma kitabu cha nabii Isaya.
sw.R: Basi Filipo aliinuka, akaenda. Njiani alimwona mtu mmoja muhimu kutoka Ethiopia, nchi ya Afrika iliyo kusini mwa Misri. Mtu huyo alikuwa towashi, mtumishi wa malkia wa Ethiopia. Malkia huyo aliitwa kwa cheo cha Kandake, na mtu huyu alitunza fedha zake zote. Alikuwa amekwenda Yerusalemu kumwabudu Mungu. \v 28 Sasa alikuwa akirudi nyumbani. Alikuwa ameketi katika gari lake la farasi, akisoma kitabu cha nabii Isaya.

vi.L: Ông đứng dậy và đi. Và kìa, có một người Ê-thi-ô-pi, là một hoạn quan, một quan chức của Can-đác, nữ hoàng nước Ê-thi-ô-pi, cai quản tất cả kho báu của bà; ông đã lên Giê-ru-sa-lem để thờ phượng, \v 28 nay đang trở về, ngồi trên xe ngựa mình mà đọc sách tiên tri Ê-sai.
vi.B: Phi-líp liền đứng dậy và đi. Trên đường, có một người Ê-thi-ô-pi, là hoạn quan, một quan chức cao cấp cai quản toàn bộ ngân khố của Can-đác, nữ hoàng nước Ê-thi-ô-pi. Ông đã lên Giê-ru-sa-lem để thờ phượng, \v 28 và bây giờ đang trên đường trở về, ngồi trên xe ngựa đọc sách tiên tri Ê-sai.
vi.R: Vậy Phi-líp đứng dậy và đi. Trên đường, ông gặp một người quan trọng đến từ Ê-thi-ô-pi, là một nước ở châu Phi, phía nam Ai Cập. Người ấy là một hoạn quan, là người phục vụ nữ hoàng nước Ê-thi-ô-pi. Nữ hoàng ấy được gọi là Can-đác, và người này coi sóc tất cả tiền bạc của bà. Ông đã lên Giê-ru-sa-lem để thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời. \v 28 Bây giờ ông đang trên đường về nhà. Ông ngồi trên xe ngựa và đọc sách của nhà tiên tri Ê-sai.

ko.L: 그래서 그는 일어나서 갔다. 그런데 보라, 에티오피아 사람인 한 내시가 있었다. 그는 에티오피아 사람들의 여왕 간다게의 신하로, 여왕의 모든 재정을 맡은 사람이었다. 그는 예배하러 예루살렘에 왔다가 \v 28 돌아가는 길에 자기 수레에 앉아 예언자 이사야의 글을 읽고 있었다.
ko.B: 빌립은 일어나서 길을 떠났다. 그런데 그 길에 에티오피아 사람인 한 내시가 있었다. 그는 에티오피아 여왕 간다게의 모든 재정을 맡은 높은 관리였다. 그는 예배하러 예루살렘에 왔다가, \v 28 이제 집으로 돌아가는 길에 수레에 앉아 예언자 이사야의 글을 읽고 있었다.
ko.R: 그래서 빌립은 일어나서 갔다. 길에서 빌립은 에티오피아에서 온 높은 사람을 보았다. 에티오피아는 이집트 남쪽, 아프리카에 있는 나라였다. 그는 내시였는데, 에티오피아 여왕을 섬기는 사람이었다. 그 여왕은 간다게라고 불렸고, 이 사람은 여왕의 돈을 모두 맡아 관리했다. 그는 하나님께 예배하러 예루살렘에 갔었다. \v 28 이제 그는 집으로 돌아가는 길이었다. 그는 수레에 앉아 예언자 이사야의 책을 읽고 있었다.

pt.L: E, levantando-se, ele foi. E eis que um homem etíope, eunuco, alto oficial de Candace, rainha dos etíopes, que estava sobre todo o tesouro dela, que tinha vindo a Jerusalém para adorar, \v 28 estava voltando e, sentado na sua carruagem, lia o profeta Isaías.
pt.B: Então Filipe se levantou e foi. E ali, na estrada, estava um homem da Etiópia, um eunuco, alto oficial encarregado de todo o tesouro de Candace, rainha dos etíopes. Ele tinha ido a Jerusalém para adorar, \v 28 e agora voltava para casa, sentado na sua carruagem, lendo o profeta Isaías.
pt.R: Então Filipe se levantou e foi. Na estrada, ele viu um homem importante da Etiópia, uma terra da África, ao sul do Egito. Esse homem era eunuco e servia a rainha da Etiópia. A rainha tinha o título de Candace, e esse homem cuidava de todo o dinheiro dela. Ele tinha ido a Jerusalém para adorar a Deus. \v 28 Agora estava voltando para casa. Estava sentado na sua carruagem e lia o livro do profeta Isaías.

am.L: ተነሥቶም ሄደ፤ እነሆም፣ የኢትዮጵያውያን ንግሥት የህንደኬ ባለ ሥልጣን የሆነ፣ በግምጃ ቤቷ ሁሉ ላይ የተሾመ፣ ሊሰግድም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጥቶ የነበረ አንድ ኢትዮጵያዊ ጃንደረባ ሰው፣ \v 28 እየተመለሰ በሰረገላው ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ ነቢዩን ኢሳይያስንም ያነብ ነበር።
am.B: ፊልጶስም ተነሥቶ ሄደ። በመንገዱም ላይ አንድ ኢትዮጵያዊ ሰው ነበር፤ እርሱም ጃንደረባ ሲሆን የኢትዮጵያውያን ንግሥት የህንደኬ ከፍተኛ ባለ ሥልጣንና በግምጃ ቤቷ ሁሉ ላይ የተሾመ ነበር። ሊሰግድ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጥቶ ነበር፤ \v 28 አሁንም ወደ አገሩ እየተመለሰ በሰረገላው ተቀምጦ ነቢዩን ኢሳይያስን ያነብ ነበር።
am.R: ስለዚህ ፊልጶስ ተነሥቶ ሄደ። በመንገድም ላይ አንድ ታላቅ ሰው አየ። ሰውየው ከግብፅ በስተ ደቡብ፣ በአባይ ወንዝ ላይ ከነበረው ከጥንቱ የኢትዮጵያ መንግሥት የመጣ ነበር። እርሱም የኢትዮጵያን ንግሥት የሚያገለግል ጃንደረባ ነበር። ንግሥቲቱ ህንደኬ ተብላ ትጠራ ነበር፤ ይህም የዚያች አገር ንግሥቶች የማዕረግ ስም ነበር። ይህ ሰው የንግሥቲቱን ገንዘብ ሁሉ ይቆጣጠር ነበር። እግዚአብሔርን ለማምለክ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሄዶ ነበር። \v 28 አሁን ወደ አገሩ እየተመለሰ ነበር። በሰረገላው ተቀምጦ የነቢዩን የኢሳይያስን መጽሐፍ ያነብ ነበር።

hi.L: और वह उठकर चल दिया; और देखो, इथियोपिया का एक पुरुष, एक खोजा, जो इथियोपियों की रानी कन्दाके का मंत्री था और उसके सारे ख़ज़ाने पर अधिकारी था, जो यरूशलेम में आराधना करने आया था, \v 28 वह लौट रहा था और अपने रथ पर बैठा हुआ यशायाह भविष्यद्वक्ता की पुस्तक पढ़ रहा था।
hi.B: तब फिलिप्पुस उठकर चल पड़ा। रास्ते में उसे इथियोपिया का एक पुरुष मिला, जो एक खोजा था और इथियोपियों की रानी कन्दाके का एक ऊँचा अधिकारी था, उसके सारे ख़ज़ाने का प्रबंधक। वह यरूशलेम में आराधना करने आया था, \v 28 और अब घर लौट रहा था। वह अपने रथ में बैठा यशायाह भविष्यद्वक्ता की पुस्तक पढ़ रहा था।
hi.R: तब फिलिप्पुस उठकर चल पड़ा। रास्ते में उसने इथियोपिया के एक बड़े आदमी को देखा। इथियोपिया अफ़्रीका में मिस्र के दक्षिण में एक देश था। वह आदमी एक खोजा था, और इथियोपिया की रानी की सेवा करता था। उस रानी की उपाधि कन्दाके थी, और यह आदमी उसके सारे धन की देखभाल करता था। वह परमेश्वर की आराधना करने यरूशलेम गया था। \v 28 अब वह अपने घर लौट रहा था। वह अपने रथ में बैठा नबी यशायाह की पुस्तक पढ़ रहा था।

ru.L: И, встав, он пошёл. И вот, человек эфиоп, евнух, вельможа Кандаки, царицы эфиопов, который был над всей её казной, который приходил в Иерусалим поклониться, \v 28 возвращался и сидел в своей колеснице и читал пророка Исаию.
ru.B: Филипп встал и пошёл. И там, на дороге, оказался человек из Эфиопии, евнух, высокий сановник, ведавший всей казной Кандаки, царицы эфиопов. Он приезжал в Иерусалим на поклонение \v 28 и теперь возвращался домой. Он сидел в своей колеснице и читал пророка Исаию.
ru.R: Филипп встал и пошёл. На дороге он увидел знатного человека из Эфиопии — страны в Африке, к югу от Египта. Это был евнух, человек, который служил царице Эфиопии. Цариц там называли Кандаками, и этот человек заведовал всеми её деньгами. Он ездил в Иерусалим, чтобы поклониться Богу. \v 28 Теперь он возвращался домой. Он сидел в своей колеснице и читал книгу пророка Исаии.

uk.L: І він, вставши, пішов. І ось чоловік-ефіоп, евнух, вельможа Кандакії, цариці ефіопів, що був над усією її скарбницею, який прийшов до Єрусалима поклонитися, \v 28 повертався й сидів у своїй колісниці, і читав пророка Ісаю.
uk.B: Тож Филип устав і пішов. А на дорозі був чоловік з Ефіопії, евнух, високий урядовець, що відав усією скарбницею Кандакії, цариці ефіопів. Він приїздив до Єрусалима поклонитися \v 28 і тепер повертався додому, сидячи в своїй колісниці й читаючи пророка Ісаю.
uk.R: Тож Филип устав і пішов. На дорозі він побачив поважного чоловіка з Ефіопії, країни в Африці на південь від Єгипту. Він був евнухом, тобто чоловіком, який служив цариці Ефіопії. Цариця мала титул Кандакія, і цей чоловік відав усіма її грішми. Він їздив до Єрусалима, щоб поклонитися Богові. \v 28 Тепер він повертався додому. Він сидів у своїй колісниці й читав книгу пророка Ісаї.

ja.L: そして彼は立ち上がって出かけて行った。するとなんと、エチオピア人の男がいた。宦官で、エチオピア人の女王カンダケの高官であり、女王の財宝のすべてを管理していた。彼は礼拝するためにエルサレムに来ていたが、\v 28 帰る途中で、自分の馬車に座って、預言者イザヤ[の書]を読んでいた。
ja.B: そこでフィリポは立って出かけた。すると、その道にエチオピア人の宦官がいた。エチオピア人の女王カンダケの高官で、女王の財宝のすべてを管理していた人である。この人は礼拝のためにエルサレムに来ていたが、\v 28 今は帰る途中で、馬車に座って預言者イザヤの書を読んでいた。
ja.R: そこでフィリポは立ち上がって、出かけて行きました。その道で、フィリポは、エチオピアから来た身分の高い人を見ました。エチオピアは、アフリカのエジプトの南にある国です。この人はかんがんで、エチオピアの女王に仕える役人でした。その女王はカンダケという称号で呼ばれていて、この人は女王のお金を全部管理していました。この人は、神を礼拝するためにエルサレムに行っていたのです。\v 28 今は国へ帰るところでした。そして、馬車に座って、預言者イザヤの書を読んでいました。

decisions.choice: Ethiopian: from the kingdom of Kush on the upper Nile, south of Egypt
alternatives: from the land now called Ethiopia
decisions.reason: The Greeks called the peoples south of Egypt Ethiopians. The kingdom Luke means had its capital at Meroë, in what is now Sudan. To Luke's readers it lay at the far edge of the known world; compare "to the end of the earth" in 1:8.

decisions.choice: eunuch: a castrated man, as many royal servants were
alternatives: simply a title for a court official
decisions.reason: The word can be a title for a high official, but here Luke has a separate word for his rank ("official"), and he goes on calling him "the eunuch". The law kept a eunuch from the assembly of the Lord (Deuteronomy 23:1), but Isaiah 56:3-5 promises eunuchs who hold to God's covenant a name better than sons and daughters.

decisions.choice: Candace: the title of the queen of Kush, not her personal name
decisions.reason: Ancient writers report that the queens, or queen mothers, of Meroë bore the title Candace (in the Meroitic language, kandake). Luke does not give the personal name of the queen.

decisions.choice: an official over all her treasure: her chief treasurer
decisions.reason: The word for official means a person of power at court. The treasure is the royal treasury.

decisions.choice: had come to worship: he worshiped the God of Israel
alternatives: he was a full convert to Judaism
decisions.reason: He had made the long journey to worship in Jerusalem and was reading the Scriptures. Luke does not say whether he was a Jew by birth, a convert, or a Gentile who worshiped God. As a eunuch he could not have entered the temple courts open to Israel.

decisions.choice: chariot: a carriage for travel
decisions.reason: The word covers any wheeled vehicle drawn by animals. He was traveling in some state, with a driver (8:38).

decisions.choice: behold: a word that points to something unexpected
decisions.reason: Luke uses it to bring a new person suddenly into view.

decisions.choice: look (L); there on the road (B); he saw (R)
decisions.reason: Modern English does not say "behold", as at 1:10.

decisions.choice: a land in Africa south of Egypt
decisions.reason: Readable says where Ethiopia was, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: the queen was called the Candace
decisions.reason: Readable shows that Candace was a title, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: a man who served the queen
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the word "eunuch" and says what work he did for the queen.

decisions.choice: carruaje
decisions.reason: A carriage for travel (meaning decision m6); in much of Latin America "carro" means a car, so "carruaje" is used at every level.

decisions.choice: mira (L); reworded as "allí, en el camino" (B) and "vio" (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide handling of this pointing word (meaning decision m7): Literal keeps it as "mira", and Balanced and Readable reword it as the English does; "he aquí" is no longer spoken Spanish.

decisions.choice: Et voici (L)
decisions.reason: English Literal says "look" because "behold" is no longer used; French "voici" is still current in written narrative and points to the unexpected sight as the Greek does (m7). Balanced says "Et justement, sur la route" and Readable "il a vu", as the English does.

decisions.choice: Isaïe
decisions.reason: The form used in general French and in the other French books of this translation; "Ésaïe" is the form of the Protestant tradition.

decisions.choice: Mwethiopia, Ethiopia, Waethiopia
decisions.reason: The Greek name, as the English "Ethiopian"; the land meant is the kingdom of Kush on the upper Nile, south of Egypt (meaning decision m1), which Readable explains as the English does. "Uhabeshi" names the later Abyssinian highlands, a different place.

decisions.choice: gari (L); gari la farasi (B, R)
decisions.reason: A carriage for travel (meaning decision m6); "gari" alone now means a motor car, so Balanced and Readable add "la farasi"; "gari la vita" would make it a war chariot.

decisions.choice: "người Ê-thi-ô-pi", "hoạn quan", "Can-đác"
decisions.reason: "hoạn quan" is the plain word for a eunuch who served a ruler; "thái giám" belongs to the Chinese court. Candace is the queen's title (meaning decision), which Readable says.

decisions.choice: "ông" for the Ethiopian in the narrative and in Philip's words; he speaks to Philip as "ông" and says "tôi"
decisions.reason: A high official and a stranger speak to each other with the courteous "ông".

decisions.choice: "에티오피아"; "내시"; "간다게"; "재정"; "수레"; "이사야"
decisions.reason: Ethiopia here is the kingdom of Kush (meaning decision); Korean uses the name the English does, in its current spelling, as with "이집트". "내시" is the Korean word for a castrated royal servant (meaning decision). "간다게" is the Protestant form of the queen's title, which Readable explains as a title, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: a carruagem
decisions.reason: For the whole book. A Brazilian "carro" is a car, and "carroça" is a farm cart; "carruagem" is a wheeled vehicle for travel drawn by animals, which suits an official traveling in some state (m6).

decisions.choice: eis que
decisions.reason: Portuguese narrative still uses "eis que" to bring something suddenly into view, and Literal keeps it, as Luke's Portuguese does (Luke 5:18); Balanced and Readable follow the English.

decisions.choice: ኢትዮጵያዊ ጃንደረባ; ህንደኬ; በግምጃ ቤቷ ላይ የተሾመ
alternatives: ቀንዳቄ (a fresh transliteration of the title)
decisions.reason: Amharic readers know this man as ኢትዮጵያዊው ጃንደረባ and the queen's title as ህንደኬ, and the Greek says 'Ethiopian', so those words stay at every level. ጃንደረባ is the Amharic word for a eunuch of the royal court, which is what the Greek means (m2); ግምጃ ቤት is the royal treasury, so 'over all her ግምጃ ቤት' makes him her chief treasurer (m4).

decisions.choice: ከግብፅ በስተ ደቡብ፣ በአባይ ወንዝ ላይ ከነበረው ከጥንቱ የኢትዮጵያ መንግሥት (from the ancient kingdom of Ethiopia on the Nile, south of Egypt)
alternatives: no explanation of where he came from
decisions.reason: The Greek 'Ethiopia' named the kingdom of Kush on the upper Nile (m1), whose queens bore the title Candace (m3); Readable says so in place of the English Readable's 'a land in Africa south of Egypt', which would tell an Ethiopian reader nothing, and says that ህንደኬ was a title, not her name.

decisions.choice: "इथियोपिया"
decisions.reason: The Greek name is used, which Hindi readers know; the meaning note says it was the kingdom of Kush on the upper Nile, and Readable says where it lay, as the English does.
"खोजा" is the Hindi word for a castrated man who served at a royal court, which is what the Greek means here (meaning decision m2); the other words carry senses that do not fit.

decisions.choice: "भविष्यद्वक्ता" (L, B); "नबी" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's word for prophet, with the everyday "नबी" at Readable; the same through this chapter. Literal and Balanced add "की पुस्तक", since one reads a prophet's book.
Literal keeps the pointing word "idou" as "देखो"; Balanced and Readable say "रास्ते में उसे ... मिला", as the English drops "behold".

decisions.choice: "Кандака"
decisions.reason: The modern transcription of the queen's title, rather than the Synodal "Кандакия"; Readable shows it is a title by saying the queens there were called so.

decisions.choice: "Кандакія"
decisions.reason: Candace is the queens' title, written as a name in the familiar Ukrainian form; Readable says it is a title, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "エチオピア人の宦官" (L, B), "かんがん" in kana (R); "カンダケ"; "高官" (L, B), "役人" (R)
decisions.reason: "宦官" is the ordinary Japanese word for a eunuch at court, and the man is called by it through the story. Its first kanji is not a Jōyō kanji, so Readable writes it in kana and says what he did for the queen. Candace is a title (m3); Readable says so, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "するとなんと" (L); "すると、その道に" (B); "見ました" (R)
decisions.reason: "見よ" is not used in narration; Literal marks the surprise with "なんと", as in 1:10 and 12:7.

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ τὸ πνεῦμα τῷ Φιλίππῳ· Πρόσελθε καὶ κολλήθητι τῷ ἅρματι τούτῳ.

records.literal_gloss: Said then the Spirit to Philip, Go near and join yourself to the chariot this.

en.L: And the Spirit said to Philip, "Go near and join this chariot."
en.B: The Spirit told Philip, "Go up to that chariot and stay with it."
en.R: The Holy Spirit said to Philip, "Go to that chariot and stay close to it."

es.L: Y el Espíritu dijo a Felipe: «Acércate y júntate a este carruaje».
es.B: El Espíritu le dijo a Felipe: «Ve hasta ese carruaje y no te separes de él».
es.R: El Espíritu Santo le dijo a Felipe: «Ve hasta ese carruaje y quédate cerca de él».

fr.L: Et l’Esprit dit à Philippe : « Approche-toi et joins-toi à ce char. »
fr.B: L’Esprit dit à Philippe : « Va jusqu’à ce char et reste à côté. »
fr.R: L’Esprit Saint a dit à Philippe : « Va vers ce char et reste tout près. »

sw.L: Na Roho akamwambia Filipo, "Sogea karibu, ujiunge na gari hili."
sw.B: Roho alimwambia Filipo, "Nenda mpaka kwenye gari lile, ukae karibu nalo."
sw.R: Roho Mtakatifu alimwambia Filipo, "Nenda kwenye gari lile, ukae karibu nalo."

vi.L: Thánh Linh phán với Phi-líp: "Hãy đến gần và theo sát cỗ xe ấy."
vi.B: Thánh Linh phán bảo Phi-líp: "Hãy đến gần cỗ xe ấy và đi theo bên cạnh."
vi.R: Đức Thánh Linh nói với Phi-líp: "Hãy đi đến cỗ xe ấy và ở gần nó."

ko.L: 그때 성령께서 빌립에게 말씀하셨다. "가까이 가서 저 수레에 바짝 붙어 가거라."
ko.B: 성령께서 빌립에게 말씀하셨다. "저 수레로 다가가서 그 곁을 따라가거라."
ko.R: 성령께서 빌립에게 말씀하셨다. "저 수레로 가서 그 곁에 바짝 붙어 따라가거라."

pt.L: E o Espírito disse a Filipe: "Aproxima-te e junta-te a esta carruagem."
pt.B: O Espírito disse a Filipe: "Vai até aquela carruagem e fica junto dela."
pt.R: O Espírito Santo disse a Filipe: "Vai até aquela carruagem e fica perto dela."

am.L: መንፈስም ፊልጶስን፦ «ቅረብና ከዚህ ሰረገላ ጋር ተጠጋ» አለው።
am.B: መንፈስም ፊልጶስን፦ «ወደዚያ ሰረገላ ሂድና ከእርሱ ጋር አብረህ ሁን» አለው።
am.R: መንፈስ ቅዱስም ፊልጶስን፦ «ወደዚያ ሰረገላ ሂድ፤ ከአጠገቡም አትራቅ» አለው።

hi.L: तब आत्मा ने फिलिप्पुस से कहा, "पास जाकर इस रथ के साथ हो लो।"
hi.B: आत्मा ने फिलिप्पुस से कहा, "उस रथ के पास जाओ और उसके साथ-साथ चलो।"
hi.R: पवित्र आत्मा ने फिलिप्पुस से कहा, "उस रथ के पास जाओ और उसके साथ-साथ चलते रहो।"

ru.L: Сказал же Дух Филиппу: «Подойди и пристань к этой колеснице.»
ru.B: Дух сказал Филиппу: «Подойди к той колеснице и держись рядом с ней.»
ru.R: Святой Дух сказал Филиппу: «Иди к той колеснице и держись рядом с ней.»

uk.L: І Дух сказав Филипові: «Підійди й пристань до цієї колісниці.»
uk.B: Дух сказав Филипові: «Підійди до тієї колісниці й тримайся біля неї.»
uk.R: Святий Дух сказав Филипові: «Іди до тієї колісниці й тримайся близько до неї.»

ja.L: そして霊がフィリポに言われた。「近寄って、この馬車に付いて行きなさい。」
ja.B: 霊はフィリポに言われた。「あの馬車に近づいて、離れずに行きなさい。」
ja.R: 聖霊がフィリポに言われました。「あの馬車のところに行って、そばを離れないようにしなさい。」

decisions.choice: the Spirit: the Holy Spirit, who guides Philip
decisions.reason: Luke speaks first of an angel (8:26) and now of the Spirit. The Spirit directs the mission again in 10:19, 13:2 and 16:6-7.

decisions.choice: join: keep close to, go along beside
decisions.reason: The verb means to join oneself to something. Philip is to walk or run beside the chariot; the official invites him up in 8:31.

decisions.choice: that chariot
decisions.reason: English points to something at a distance with "that".

decisions.choice: "Thánh Linh phán" (L, B); "nói" (R) for the Spirit speaking (also 10:19; 11:12; 13:2)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese 1 Timothy 4:1: "phán" for God speaking at Literal and Balanced, with Readable's plainer verb.

decisions.choice: the Spirit speaks in 해라체, with the honorific in the narrative ("성령께서 ... 말씀하셨다")
decisions.reason: As God speaks in 해라체 (style guide, section 7a), and as the Spirit is honoured in the narrative (1:8).

decisions.choice: tu (Aproxima-te, Vai, fica)
decisions.reason: The Holy Spirit speaks to Philip directly, as God, so the address follows docs/portuguese-style.md section 4: God speaking to a person uses "tu". The angel in 8:26 is a messenger and speaks as people do, with "você".

source.text: προσδραμὼν δὲ ὁ Φίλιππος ἤκουσεν αὐτοῦ ἀναγινώσκοντος Ἠσαΐαν τὸν προφήτην καὶ εἶπεν· Ἆρά γε γινώσκεις ἃ ἀναγινώσκεις;

records.literal_gloss: Having run up then the Philip heard him reading Isaiah the prophet and said, Then indeed do you understand what you are reading?

en.L: And Philip ran up and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and he said, "Do you really understand what you are reading?"
en.B: Philip ran over to him and heard him reading aloud from the prophet Isaiah. "Do you know what it is you are reading?" he asked.
en.R: Philip ran up to the chariot. He heard the man reading out loud from the prophet Isaiah. Philip asked him, "Do you understand what you are reading?"

es.L: Y Felipe, corriendo hacia él, lo oyó leer a Isaías el profeta, y dijo: «¿Acaso entiendes lo que lees?».
es.B: Felipe corrió hasta él y lo oyó leer en voz alta al profeta Isaías. «¿Sabes lo que estás leyendo?», le preguntó.
es.R: Felipe corrió hasta el carruaje. Oyó que el hombre leía en voz alta al profeta Isaías. Felipe le preguntó: «¿Entiendes lo que estás leyendo?».

fr.L: Et Philippe, étant accouru, l’entendit lire Isaïe le prophète, et il dit : « Comprends-tu donc ce que tu lis ? »
fr.B: Philippe accourut et l’entendit lire à haute voix le prophète Isaïe. « Comprends-tu ce que tu lis ? » lui demanda-t-il.
fr.R: Philippe a couru jusqu’au char. Il a entendu l’homme lire à voix haute le livre du prophète Isaïe. Philippe lui a demandé : « Est-ce que tu comprends ce que tu lis ? »

sw.L: Na Filipo, akiisha kukimbia karibu, alimsikia akisoma [kitabu cha] Isaya nabii, akasema, "Je, kweli unaelewa unachosoma?"
sw.B: Filipo alikimbia mpaka kwake, akamsikia akisoma kwa sauti kitabu cha nabii Isaya. "Je, unajua ni nini unachosoma?" akamwuliza.
sw.R: Filipo alikimbia mpaka kwenye gari. Alimsikia mtu huyo akisoma kwa sauti kitabu cha nabii Isaya. Filipo akamwuliza, "Je, unaelewa unachosoma?"

vi.L: Phi-líp chạy đến, nghe ông đang đọc sách tiên tri Ê-sai, liền hỏi: "Ông có thật hiểu điều ông đang đọc không?"
vi.B: Phi-líp chạy đến, nghe ông đang đọc lớn sách tiên tri Ê-sai, và hỏi: "Ông có hiểu điều ông đang đọc không?"
vi.R: Phi-líp chạy đến bên cỗ xe. Ông nghe người ấy đang đọc lớn tiếng sách tiên tri Ê-sai. Phi-líp hỏi người ấy: "Ông có hiểu điều ông đang đọc không?"

ko.L: 빌립이 달려가서, 그가 예언자 이사야의 글을 읽고 있는 것을 듣고 말했다. "읽고 계신 것을 정말 이해하십니까?"
ko.B: 빌립이 달려가서 들어 보니, 그가 예언자 이사야의 글을 소리 내어 읽고 있었다. 빌립이 물었다. "지금 읽고 계신 것을 이해하십니까?"
ko.R: 빌립은 수레로 달려갔다. 그는 그 사람이 예언자 이사야의 글을 소리 내어 읽고 있는 것을 들었다. 빌립이 그에게 물었다. "읽고 계신 것을 이해하십니까?"

pt.L: E Filipe, correndo até lá, ouviu-o lendo o profeta Isaías e disse: "Será que o senhor entende de fato o que está lendo?"
pt.B: Filipe correu até ele e o ouviu lendo em voz alta o profeta Isaías. "O senhor sabe o que é isso que está lendo?" perguntou ele.
pt.R: Filipe correu até a carruagem. Ele ouviu o homem lendo em voz alta o livro do profeta Isaías. Filipe perguntou: "O senhor entende o que está lendo?"

am.L: ፊልጶስም ሮጦ ሲደርስ ነቢዩን ኢሳይያስን ሲያነብ ሰማውና፦ «በእርግጥ የሚያነቡትን ያስተውሉታልን?» አለው።
am.B: ፊልጶስም ወደ እርሱ ሮጦ ሄደ፤ ከነቢዩ ከኢሳይያስ መጽሐፍ ጮክ ብሎ ሲያነብም ሰማው። «የሚያነቡት ምን እንደ ሆነ ያውቃሉን?» ብሎ ጠየቀው።
am.R: ፊልጶስ ወደ ሰረገላው ሮጠ። ሰውየው ከነቢዩ ከኢሳይያስ መጽሐፍ ጮክ ብሎ ሲያነብ ሰማ። ፊልጶስም፦ «የሚያነቡትን ይረዱታል?» ብሎ ጠየቀው።

hi.L: फिलिप्पुस ने दौड़कर उसे यशायाह भविष्यद्वक्ता [की पुस्तक] पढ़ते सुना और कहा, "क्या आप सचमुच समझते हैं कि आप क्या पढ़ रहे हैं?"
hi.B: फिलिप्पुस दौड़कर उसके पास गया और उसे ऊँचे स्वर से यशायाह भविष्यद्वक्ता की पुस्तक पढ़ते सुना। "आप जो पढ़ रहे हैं, क्या उसे समझते भी हैं?" उसने पूछा।
hi.R: फिलिप्पुस दौड़कर रथ के पास पहुँचा। उसने सुना कि वह आदमी नबी यशायाह की पुस्तक ज़ोर से पढ़ रहा है। फिलिप्पुस ने उससे पूछा, "आप जो पढ़ रहे हैं, क्या उसे समझते हैं?"

ru.L: Подбежав же, Филипп услышал, как он читает пророка Исаию, и сказал: «Понимаешь ли ты то, что читаешь?»
ru.B: Филипп подбежал к нему и услышал, что тот читает вслух пророка Исаию. «Ты понимаешь, что читаешь?» — спросил он.
ru.R: Филипп подбежал к колеснице. Он услышал, как человек читает вслух пророка Исаию. Филипп спросил его: «Ты понимаешь, что ты читаешь?»

uk.L: А Филип, підбігши, почув, як той читав пророка Ісаю, і сказав: «Чи ж розумієш ти, що читаєш?»
uk.B: Филип підбіг до нього й почув, як він уголос читає пророка Ісаю. «Чи розумієш ти, що читаєш?» — запитав він.
uk.R: Филип підбіг до колісниці. Він почув, як чоловік уголос читає пророка Ісаю. Филип запитав його: «Ти розумієш, що читаєш?»

ja.L: そこでフィリポが走り寄ると、彼が預言者イザヤ[の書]を読んでいるのが聞こえた。そして言った。「読んでいることが、本当にわかりますか？」
ja.B: フィリポは走り寄って、その人が預言者イザヤの書を声に出して読んでいるのを聞いた。「何を読んでいるのか、おわかりですか？」とフィリポは尋ねた。
ja.R: フィリポは馬車のところに走って行きました。すると、その人が預言者イザヤの書を声に出して読んでいるのが聞こえました。フィリポはその人に尋ねました。「読んでいることがわかりますか？」

decisions.choice: heard him reading: he was reading aloud
decisions.reason: People in the ancient world usually read aloud, even when alone.

decisions.choice: do you understand what you are reading: a play on two related verbs, to know and to read
decisions.reason: In Greek, "understand" and "read" share a root, and the question plays on them. The opening particles show the question expects the answer "no" or invites a doubt.

decisions.choice: reading aloud (B); reading out loud (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say how Philip could hear him, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: tu between Philip and the official
alternatives: vous, for a high official and a stranger
decisions.reason: The style guide follows the Greek number: "tu" to one person, "vous" to several, with no social distinction. The official also says "tu" to Philip (8:34).

decisions.choice: Philip and the official speak to each other in 합쇼체 with the honorific (8:30-36), and the official says "저"
decisions.reason: Two strangers meeting on the road, one of them a high official: Korean courtesy calls for the formal polite style on both sides. The official's humble "How could I" (meaning decision) is said with "저".

decisions.choice: o senhor
decisions.reason: Philip speaks to a high royal official he does not know, so he uses "o senhor", as Brazilians address a superior (Acts note: people to officials). The official answers with no form of address.

decisions.choice: እርስዎ forms from Philip to the official (ያስተውሉታልን, ያውቃሉን, ይረዱታል); አንተ forms from the official to Philip (እለምንሃለሁ, እባክህ)
alternatives: አንተ forms both ways, as the Greek singular
decisions.reason: Philip, a stranger on foot, speaks to a high official of a royal court, and in Amharic he would use the respectful እርስዎ, as subjects do to rulers elsewhere; the official answers with the plain አንተ he would use to a younger man. The narrative keeps the plain third person for both. A reviewer may prefer እርስዎ for the official's polite request too (8:34).

decisions.choice: "आप"
decisions.reason: Philip speaks to a high official of a queen, a stranger; Hindi gives him the respectful "आप", and the official answers Philip with "आप" too (8:34).

decisions.choice: "розумієш ... читаєш"
decisions.reason: The Greek plays on two related verbs (ginōskeis ... anaginōskeis); Ukrainian cannot keep the pun, so it gives the plain sense.

decisions.choice: Philip and the official speak politely to each other (です・ます)
decisions.reason: They are strangers, and the official is a man of rank, so both speak politely through the scene. Japanese cannot keep the Greek play on "know" and "read" (m2).

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Πῶς γὰρ ἂν δυναίμην ἐὰν μή τις ὁδηγήσει με;

records.literal_gloss: He and said, How for could I be able, if not someone will guide me?

en.L: And he said, "How could I, unless someone guides me?"
en.B: "How could I," he said, "if no one guides me?"
en.R: The man answered, "How can I understand it? I need someone to explain it to me."

es.L: Y él dijo: «¿Cómo podría, si alguien no me guía?».
es.B: «¿Cómo voy a poder —respondió—, si nadie me guía?».
es.R: El hombre respondió: «¿Cómo voy a entenderlo? Necesito que alguien me lo explique».

fr.L: Et il dit : « Comment donc le pourrais-je, à moins que quelqu’un ne me guide ? »
fr.B: « Comment le pourrais-je, répondit-il, si personne ne me guide ? »
fr.R: L’homme a répondu : « Comment est-ce que je pourrais comprendre ? J’ai besoin que quelqu’un me l’explique. »

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Ningewezaje, mtu asiponiongoza?"
sw.B: "Ningewezaje," akasema, "kama hakuna mtu wa kuniongoza?"
sw.R: Mtu huyo akajibu, "Nitaelewaje? Ninahitaji mtu wa kunieleza."

vi.L: Ông nói: "Làm sao tôi hiểu được, nếu không có ai hướng dẫn tôi?"
vi.B: Ông đáp: "Làm sao tôi hiểu được, nếu không có ai hướng dẫn?"
vi.R: Người ấy trả lời: "Làm sao tôi hiểu được? Tôi cần có người giải thích cho tôi."

ko.L: 그가 말했다. "누가 저를 이끌어 주지 않으면 제가 어떻게 알 수 있겠습니까?"
ko.B: 그가 대답했다. "누가 저를 이끌어 주지 않으면 제가 어떻게 알겠습니까?"
ko.R: 그 사람이 대답했다. "제가 어떻게 이해할 수 있겠습니까? 누가 저에게 설명해 주어야 합니다."

pt.L: E ele disse: "Como, pois, eu poderia, se alguém não me guiar?"
pt.B: "Como eu poderia", disse ele, "se ninguém me orientar?"
pt.R: O homem respondeu: "Como vou entender? Preciso de alguém que me explique."

am.L: እርሱም፦ «ማንም ካልመራኝ እንዴት ልችል?» አለ።
am.B: እርሱም፦ «እንዴት ልረዳው እችላለሁ» አለ፤ «የሚመራኝ ሰው ከሌለ?»
am.R: ሰውየውም፦ «እንዴት ልረዳው እችላለሁ? የሚያስረዳኝ ሰው ያስፈልገኛል» ብሎ መለሰ።

hi.L: उसने कहा, "जब तक कोई मुझे मार्ग न दिखाए, तो मैं कैसे समझ सकता हूँ?"
hi.B: "जब तक कोई मुझे समझाए नहीं," उसने कहा, "मैं कैसे समझूँ?"
hi.R: उस आदमी ने उत्तर दिया, "मैं इसे कैसे समझ सकता हूँ? मुझे कोई चाहिए जो इसे मुझे समझाए।"

ru.L: Он же сказал: «Как же я могу, если кто-нибудь не наставит меня?»
ru.B: «Как же я пойму», — сказал он, — «если никто меня не наставит?»
ru.R: Человек ответил: «Как я могу это понять? Мне нужен кто-то, кто мне это объяснит.»

uk.L: А він сказав: «Як же я зможу, якщо хтось не наставить мене?»
uk.B: «Як же я можу», — сказав він, — «коли ніхто мене не наставить?»
uk.R: Чоловік відповів: «Як я можу це зрозуміти? Мені потрібен хтось, хто пояснить мені.»

ja.L: すると彼は言った。「だれかが導いてくれなければ、どうしてわかるでしょうか？」
ja.B: 「どうしてわかるでしょうか？」と彼は言った。「だれかが手引きしてくれなければ。」
ja.R: その人は答えました。「どうしてわかるでしょうか？だれかに説明してもらわなければなりません。」

decisions.choice: guide: lead the way, explain
decisions.reason: The verb means to lead on the way. Jesus promised that the Spirit would guide his followers into all the truth (John 16:13).

decisions.choice: how could I: a humble admission, not a complaint
decisions.reason: The "for" ties his answer to Philip's question: no, for how could he?

decisions.choice: a question and a plain statement
decisions.reason: Readable states what the question implies.

source.text: παρεκάλεσέν τε τὸν Φίλιππον ἀναβάντα καθίσαι σὺν αὐτῷ.

records.literal_gloss: He invited then the Philip having come up to sit with him.

en.L: And he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.
en.B: He asked Philip to climb up and sit beside him.
en.R: So he asked Philip to come up into the chariot and sit with him.

es.L: Y rogó a Felipe que subiera y se sentara con él.
es.B: Y le pidió a Felipe que subiera y se sentara a su lado.
es.R: Así que le pidió a Felipe que subiera al carruaje y se sentara con él.

fr.L: Et il invita Philippe à monter s’asseoir avec lui.
fr.B: Et il pria Philippe de monter s’asseoir à côté de lui.
fr.R: Alors il a demandé à Philippe de monter dans le char et de s’asseoir avec lui.

sw.L: Akamsihi Filipo apande na kuketi pamoja naye.
sw.B: Akamwomba Filipo apande, aketi kando yake.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo akamwomba Filipo apande ndani ya gari, aketi pamoja naye.

vi.L: Ông mời Phi-líp lên ngồi với mình.
vi.B: Ông mời Phi-líp lên ngồi bên cạnh.
vi.R: Vì vậy ông mời Phi-líp lên xe ngồi với mình.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 빌립에게 올라와 자기 곁에 앉으라고 청했다.
ko.B: 그리고 그는 빌립에게 수레에 올라와 자기 곁에 앉으라고 청했다.
ko.R: 그래서 그는 빌립에게 수레에 올라와서 함께 앉자고 청했다.

pt.L: E convidou Filipe a subir e sentar-se com ele.
pt.B: E pediu a Filipe que subisse e se sentasse ao lado dele.
pt.R: Então ele pediu a Filipe que subisse na carruagem e se sentasse com ele.

am.L: ፊልጶስንም ወጥቶ ከእርሱ ጋር እንዲቀመጥ ለመነው።
am.B: ፊልጶስንም ወደ ሰረገላው ወጥቶ ከአጠገቡ እንዲቀመጥ ለመነው።
am.R: ስለዚህ ፊልጶስ ወደ ሰረገላው ወጥቶ ከእርሱ ጋር እንዲቀመጥ ጠየቀው።

hi.L: और उसने फिलिप्पुस से विनती की कि ऊपर आकर उसके साथ बैठे।
hi.B: उसने फिलिप्पुस से कहा कि वह ऊपर चढ़कर उसके पास बैठ जाए।
hi.R: इसलिए उसने फिलिप्पुस से कहा कि वह रथ में ऊपर आकर उसके साथ बैठ जाए।

ru.B: Он попросил Филиппа подняться и сесть рядом с ним.
ru.R: И он попросил Филиппа подняться к нему в колесницу и сесть с ним.

uk.B: І він попросив Филипа піднятися й сісти поруч із ним.

ja.R: それで、フィリポに、馬車に上って来て一緒に座ってほしいと頼みました。
